name_ar: باحث القدرات ثنائي اللغة بلا اتصال
what: يرتّب قدرات كتالوج KOSIF لمهمة مكتوبة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية بمطابقة موزونة للحقول مع ترجيح الكلمات النادرة في فهرس الأطلس المحلي، ويعيد المعرّفات والكلمات المطابقة والحالة المعلنة والمتطلبات مع التنبيه إلى أنها لم يُتحقَّق منها تشغيليًا. — Ranks KOSIF catalog powers for an Arabic or English task using weighted field matching with corpus-rarity scoring over the local atlas index, and returns IDs, matched terms, claimed status and requirements with runtime_verified=false.
when: ابحث عن قدرات لتحريك شخصيات في فيديو / Find KOSIF powers for blender 3d geometry
how: task (positional): `python3 scripts/ai_tool_discovery.py "تحريك شخصيات فيديو" --top 8`; --doctor: `python3 scripts/ai_tool_discovery.py --doctor`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool ai-tool-discovery`. Limits: Lexical rarity-weighted ranking over the prebuilt atlas index; it neither checks that the index is fresh nor that requirements are met on this host, and it runs nothing.
params: in: A task phrase in Arabic or English. It reads data/capability_atlas_index.json. · out: JSON on stdout (schema kosif.original-discovery.v1).
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يطبع إحاطة ذاتية سريعة لـ Claude تشمل معلومات الجهاز، وأعداد القدرات في كل مجال، وعدد القدرات التي تتوفر كل متطلباتها المسجّلة، والتثبيتات التي تفتح أكبر عدد من القدرات، وعدد الأدوات القابلة للتشغيل، والأوامر التالية المقترحة (hub.py وthink.py وrequirements.py). ويستطيع أيضًا إعادة توليد الملفين CAPABILITIES.md وllms.txt في جذر المستودع أو فحص تقادمهما. — Prints a short self-briefing for Claude: machine facts, catalog counts per domain, how many powers have every listed requirement present, the installs that unlock the most powers, the runnable-tool count and the next commands to run (hub.py, think.py, requirements.py). It can also regenerate or check the repo-root CAPABILITIES.md and llms.txt.
when: ابدأ الجلسة وقولي تقدر تعمل ايه هنا / Boot the KOSIF skill and brief yourself first
how: live: `python3 scripts/boot.py`; json: `python3 scripts/boot.py --json`; static-check: `python3 scripts/boot.py --static --check`; static-write: `python3 scripts/boot.py --static --write`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool boot`. Limits: 'Ready now' means only that every listed requirement was detected, and powers with no listed requirement (including documented, seen and idea records) also count, so it is not proof that any power works.
params: in: No input for the live briefing. Reads data/powers/*.json, data/requirements.json and data/tools.json, and checks PATH, Python import specs, environment-variable names and font files to decide what is present. --static also reads data/styles.json, repos.json and references/guides/*.md. · out: Text or JSON on stdout (exit 0). --static --write overwrites CAPABILITIES.md and llms.txt at the repo root and prints 'wrote <file>'. --static --check exits 1 and names each stale file. --write or --check without --static is ignored and prints the live briefing.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يبحث بالعربية أو الإنجليزية في كتالوج KOSIF الذي يضم 4,751 قدرة، ويخطط للمهمة باختيار معرّفات القدرات ومهارات العمل والمسارات المناسبة مع فحص المتطلبات محليًا، ويعيد بناء فهرس الأطلس ودليله. — Searches the 4,751-power KOSIF catalog in Arabic or English, plans a task by picking capability IDs, process skills, routes and local requirement checks, and rebuilds the atlas index and its guide.
when: ايه القدرات اللي تنفع لمهمة تايبوغرافي عربي متحرك؟ / Which KOSIF powers match 'Arabic kinetic typography'?
how: stats: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py stats --json`; doctor: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py doctor --json`; search: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py search "Arabic kinetic typography" --top 10 --domain motion --json`; plan: `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py plan "Build a secure accounting app" --top 7 --json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool capability-atlas`. Limits: Ranks by keyword overlap with catalog text and checks requirements only by PATH or import-spec lookup (pip requirements are looked up by distribution name, so installed Pillow or OpenCV show as not_detected); it never runs or verifies any capability.
params: in: A task phrase in Arabic or English, or a capability ID. It reads data/powers/*.json and data/capability_routes.json, plus data/capability_atlas_index.json when the index is fresh. · out: JSON on stdout for every command. build also writes data/capability_atlas_index.json and references/capability-atlas.md.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يطابق مهمة مكتوبة بالعربية أو الإنجليزية مع مسارات KOSIF الاثنين والعشرين في data/capability_routes.json (منها 17 مسارًا لها سكربت محلي و5 خارجية)، ويعيد لكل مسار أمر التشغيل والأدوات الموجودة والناقصة والأذونات المطلوبة التي لم تُمنح بعد، مع حالة لا تدّعي أن شيئًا نُفّذ. — Matches an Arabic or English task to the 22 KOSIF routes in data/capability_routes.json (17 backed by a local script, 5 external) and returns, for each one, the runbook command, which binaries are present or missing, the permissions it needs that have not been granted, and a status that never claims execution.
when: حلل فيديو مرجعي وأنتج مونتاج مشابه بأصولي، أي سكربت أشغّل؟ / Which KOSIF script should I run to analyze song energy?
how: --task: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --task "حلل فيديو مرجعي وأنتج مونتاج مشابه بأصولي" --limit 5 --json`; --id: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --id reference-edit-remix --json`; --doctor: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --doctor --json`; --list: `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --list --json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool capability-runtime-router`. Limits: Matches only against hand-written aliases for 22 routes and checks binaries on PATH; it never runs a runbook, never verifies permissions and never proves that a route works.
params: in: A task text or a route ID. It reads data/capability_routes.json (schema kosif.capability-routes.v1, at most 100 routes). · out: JSON on stdout (errors as JSON on stderr with exit code 2). Each route gets one of four statuses: source_present_not_executed, missing_host_prerequisites, source_file_missing or external_not_integrated. Runbooks use a $SKILL_DIR placeholder. executed_in_current_request and verified_in_current_request are always false.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: سؤال واحد يعطي كل ما يلزم: الأدوات القابلة للتشغيل للمهمة بأمر جاهز ومعرفة هل يملك الجهاز مستلزماتها، والقدرات المناسبة من الكتالوج، والأدلة، والأساليب المرجعية لطلبات الموشن. — One question in, everything relevant out: the runnable tools for a task (with a copy-paste command and whether this machine has their requirements), the catalog powers, the guides and, for motion work, reference styles.
when: ابدأ أي مهمة: ايش الأداة اللي أشغّلها؟ / which KOSIF tool should I run for this task?
how: find: `python3 scripts/hub.py find "اعمل فيديو موشن عربي متزامن مع صوتي"`; tool: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool native-3d`; list: `python3 scripts/hub.py list --area 3d`; areas: `python3 scripts/hub.py areas`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool hub`. Limits: Ranks by keywords, registry metadata and catalog families; a high score means relevant, not proven to work for this exact request — open the tool card and run its doctor first.
params: in: a task in the user's words, a tool id, a power id or search words · out: ranked tools, powers, guides and styles as text or JSON; build writes manifest.json, references/INDEX.md and the hub blocks in SKILL.md and references/guides/*.md
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: خادم MCP للقراءة فقط عبر stdio يتيح لأي عميل MCP (Claude Code وClaude Desktop وCursor وغيرها) طرح أسئلة hub.py نفسها: البحث، بطاقات الأدوات، الجاهزية، القدرات وعائلاتها، والأدلة. — Read-only stdio MCP server that lets any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor …) ask the same questions as hub.py: find, tool cards, doctor, power search and records, families and guides.
when: اربط Claude Desktop بكتالوج قدرات KOSIF / expose the KOSIF catalog to Cursor or another MCP client
how: serve: `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py`; selftest: `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py --selftest`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool kosif-mcp`. Limits: Answers questions only: it never runs a tool, installs, writes files or touches the network; query text is capped at 2,000 characters and list sizes at 50. For bounded file access use kosif-remote-commander.
params: in: MCP JSON-RPC requests on stdin · out: JSON-RPC responses on stdout; guide text is limited to files inside the skill folder
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: مدخل يعمل محليًا بلا شبكة وبلا استنساخ للمستودع. يفحص الأمر doctor المهارة المثبتة ويعرض عدد سجلات الكتالوج حسب الحالة ووجود أطلس الأساليب الكامل، ويحيل الأمر search البحث إلى كتالوج القدرات المحلي أو إلى أطلس الأساليب عند توفر نسخة كاملة من المستودع. — A no-network, no-clone entry point. `doctor` checks the installed skill and reports catalog record counts by status and whether the full style atlas is present; `search` forwards to the local power catalog or, inside a full kosif-tool checkout, to the style atlas.
when: شغّل المهارة من غير ما تعمل git clone / Auto mode blocked the clone, so use the installed skill instead
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/local_first.py doctor`; search-powers: `python3 scripts/local_first.py search neon glow --scope powers`; search-styles: `python3 scripts/local_first.py search sketch --scope styles`; search-auto: `python3 scripts/local_first.py search silhouette`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool local-first`. Limits: It never fetches, clones or installs anything, so in a standalone skill bundle the style atlas stays unavailable; doctor counts records and does not prove that any power runs.
params: in: Optional --skill-dir (default: this skill's folder), search words, and --scope auto|styles|powers. · out: doctor prints JSON on stdout. search prints the results of powers.py search or tools/kosif.py search and passes on its exit code. It exits 2 with a JSON error on stdout when --scope styles is requested but the atlas is absent, and exits 1 with a JSON error on stderr for an invalid skill dir.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يبيّن لكل توزيعة بايثون مذكورة (حتى 50 توزيعة) هل بياناتها الوصفية مثبتة وما إصدارها، دون استيرادها أو تثبيتها أو الاتصال بالشبكة. — Reports whether each named Python distribution (up to 50) has installed metadata and which version it is, without importing, installing or contacting the network.
when: هل pandas وnumpy متسطبين على الجهاز ده؟ / Check which of pandas, numpy and httpx are installed here
how: probe (positional names): `python3 scripts/python_package_probe.py pandas numpy httpx`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool python-package-probe`. Limits: Reads installed distribution metadata only and never imports the package, so a found package is not proven to import or work.
params: in: From 1 to 50 pip distribution names, such as pillow or opencv-python-headless. Import names such as PIL or cv2 are reported as not found. · out: JSON on stdout with the Python version, one record per package and the scope current_environment_only_no_install_no_network.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يختار للمهمة مجموعة مرتّبة من مهارات العمل الخمس عشرة المضمّنة من obra/superpowers الإصدار 7 (مثل العصف الذهني وتتبّع الأخطاء والتطوير المقاد بالاختبارات والتحقق)، ويفحص المصادر المضمّنة، ويستطيع تثبيت KOSIF مع تلك المهارات في ‎~/.claude/skills مع نسخ احتياطية. — Picks an ordered subset of the 15 vendored obra/superpowers v7 process skills (brainstorming, debugging, TDD, verification and others) for a task, checks the vendored sources, and can install KOSIF plus those skills into ~/.claude/skills with backups.
when: أي مهارات عمل أستخدمها لإصلاح عطل في التطبيق؟ / Which process skills apply to 'Fix the crash in the montage app'?
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py doctor`; plan: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py plan "Fix the crash in the montage app"`; list: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py list`; install: `python3 scripts/superpowers_unified.py install --no-global-instructions`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool superpowers-unified`. Limits: plan is a fixed keyword-to-skill lookup and doctor checks only that files exist; neither one runs, verifies or tests any skill.
params: in: A task text for plan. It reads vendor/obra-superpowers-v7/skills/*/SKILL.md and LICENSE. install targets the user's home directory (~/.claude). · out: JSON on stdout. install also writes ~/.claude/skills/<name>/, ~/.claude/backups/kosif-ultimate-<stamp>/ and, unless --no-global-instructions, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يحسب تقديرًا تقريبيًا حتميًا لسعة النظام (متوسط الطلبات في الثانية وذروتها، والحد الأدنى من النسخ المتماثلة، والتخزين المنطقي والمكرَّر بالبايت والجيبيبايت) انطلاقًا من افتراضات الحِمل والعتاد التي يقدّمها المستخدم، وبحساب عشري دقيق. — Computes a deterministic back-of-envelope capacity estimate (average and peak RPS, minimum replicas, logical and replicated storage in bytes and GiB) from caller-supplied traffic and hardware assumptions, using exact decimal arithmetic.
when: احسب لي كم سيرفر محتاج لو عندي مليون طلب في اليوم / estimate replicas and storage for 10M requests per day
how: size: `python3 scripts/architecture_sizer.py --daily-requests 86400 --peak-factor 5 --payload-bytes 1000 --retention-days 7 --replica-rps 100 --target-utilization 0.5 --copies 2`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool architecture-sizer`. Limits: Linear arithmetic on assumed numbers only; it runs no load test and leaves out indexes, log overhead, backups, compression, burst shape, network, CDN, failover headroom and regional placement.
params: in: Six required decimal assumptions, each finite and > 0: --daily-requests, --peak-factor (>= 1), --payload-bytes, --retention-days, --replica-rps and --target-utilization (<= 1); plus optional --copies (a positive integer, default 1). · out: JSON on stdout (status deterministic_estimate_not_load_test, executed_benchmark false). It exits 2 with an argparse error on missing, non-numeric or out-of-range inputs.
section: Think, ideate and write / التفكير والأفكار والكتابة

what: يحوّل وصف مشكلة واحدة إلى قائمة JSON مرتّبة وقابلة لإعادة الإنتاج من أفكار هندسية قابلة للتفنيد (16 طريقة ابتكار على نهج TRIZ × 4 زوايا)، لكل فكرة فرضية واختبار ومقياس نجاح وحدّ للرفض. — Turns one problem statement into a reproducible, ranked JSON list of falsifiable engineering ideas (16 TRIZ-style inventive methods × 4 lenses), each with a hypothesis, test, success metric and rejection threshold.
when: اقترح لي حلول مبتكرة لمشكلة بطء الترجمة على الموبايل / brainstorm falsifiable engineering alternatives for this bottleneck
how: methods: `python3 scripts/invention_lab.py methods`; invent: `python3 scripts/invention_lab.py invent "Make Arabic captions render faster on mobile" --count 12 --constraint "no paid APIs"`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool invention-lab`. Limits: Fills fixed templates from the problem string and ranks them with a SHA-256-seeded heuristic, so it gives no real novelty, feasibility, cost or patent assessment.
params: in: methods: nothing. invent: a problem statement of 8-2000 characters after whitespace normalization (positional), optional --count 1-64 (default 12) and repeatable --constraint strings. · out: JSON on stdout. For invent: schema kosif-invention-candidates-v1 with problem, constraints, disclaimer and candidates (id, method, lens, proposal, hypothesis, test, success_metric, failure_threshold, novelty_status, risk, cost_class, priority_score). Exit 2 with an argparse error for a missing/short problem or an out-of-range --count.
section: Think, ideate and write / التفكير والأفكار والكتابة

what: يحوّل ملف JSON بصيغة kosif.audio-cues.v1 (بدايات الأصوات المقيسة والكلمات المحاذاة الناتجة عن audio_cue_mapper.py) إلى لوحة قصة قابلة للتحرير بصيغة motion_director، فيها نص موقوت ومسار يُرسم تدريجيًا وشخصية وتقريب للكاميرا، مع تقرير قرار يقيّم أساليب doodle وkinetic وcinematic. — Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON (measured onsets plus aligned words from audio_cue_mapper.py) into an editable motion_director storyboard with timed text, a draw-on path, a character and a camera zoom, plus a decision report that scores the doodle, kinetic and cinematic styles.
when: حوّل التعليق الصوتي وتوقيت الكلمات لستوري بورد موشن جرافيك / turn my audio cues and word timings into an editable motion storyboard
how: plan (auto style): `python3 scripts/creative_reasoning_bridge.py ./cues.json --style auto --out ./out/scene.json --report ./out/decision.json`; plan (forced style, landscape): `python3 scripts/creative_reasoning_bridge.py ./cues.json --style kinetic --landscape --out ./out/scene.json --report ./out/decision.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-reasoning-bridge`. Limits: Builds an unrendered storyboard from a hand-written style heuristic and amplitude onsets; it does not understand lyrics or emotion, verify beats or render video.
params: in: A kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON produced by scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py (duration 0.1-120 s, up to 600 onset candidates, up to 1,500 non-overlapping timed words), plus --out and --report paths that are new, distinct and inside directories that already exist. · out: Two new JSON files: the storyboard (motion_director spec version 1, ready for 'motion_director.py compile') and the report (schema kosif.creative-plan.v1: decision with style scores and limitations, evidence, validated_storyboard, render_status unrendered_storyboard). A one-line JSON summary is printed to stdout.
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

name_ar: مُصرِّف حركة SVG المتزامنة مع الصوت
what: يتحقق من ملف مشاهد بصيغة JSON مُوقَّت على مستوى الكلمات (مسارات ودوائر ونصوص وشخصيات وممثلون بمفاصل وتحوّلات أشكال وحركة كاميرا)، ثم يحوّله إلى رسم متحرك SVG/HTML مستقل يمكن الانتقال فيه إلى أي لحظة، مع تصيير اختياري إلى MP4 عبر render_html.cjs. — Validates a word-timed JSON scene spec (paths, circles, text, characters, rigged actors, morphs, camera) and compiles it into a self-contained seekable SVG/HTML animation, with an optional MP4 render through render_html.cjs.
when: اعمل لي موشن جرافيك عربي متزامن مع الكلمات من ملف JSON / Compile this word-timed scene JSON into a seekable SVG explainer
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py doctor`; sample: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py sample --out ./scene.json`; compile: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py compile ./scene.json --out ./out/scene.html`; render: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py render ./out/scene.html --out ./out/scene.mp4 --audio ./voice.wav`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-director`. Limits: Compiles only its own validated vector primitives (≤80 elements, ≤120 s); it does not read words.json directly, transcribe or align audio, or verify the rendered MP4.
params: in: Motion Director spec JSON v1: even width/height 320–4096, fps 24/25/30/60, duration 0.1–120 s, 1–30 continuous scenes with monotonic word timings (≤240 words each), camera zoom/pan, ≤80 elements in total of type path|circle|text|character|actor|morph with hex colours; for render an existing HTML file, a new .mp4 path and an optional audio file. · out: JSON status on stdout; sample spec JSON; self-contained seekable HTML animation; optional MP4 (unverified) from render. Exit 0 ok, 1 render_failed, 2 validation/IO error.
install: optional: bin:chromium, bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe, bin:node, npm:playwright
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: سكربت يعمل في المتصفح يدمجه الأمر motion_director.py compile، يقرأ بيانات المشاهد بصيغة JSON من الوسم <script id=kosif-data> ويحرّك فيلم SVG بشكل حتمي: يرسم الخطوط تدريجيًا، ويُظهر النصوص بالتلاشي، ويحوّل المضلعات من شكل إلى آخر، ويحرّك شخصية خطية وممثلين بمفاصل محورية (مشي، جري، تلويح، إشارة، جلوس) مع رأس قلم متحرك، ويكبّر الكاميرا ويحرّكها لكل مشهد، ويعرض ترجمة عربية من اليمين إلى اليسار موقّتة بالكلمات، وكل ذلك عبر الدالة window.__kosif.seek(t) لرندر دقيق إطارًا بإطار. — A browser-side script (IIFE), inlined by motion_director.py compile, that reads scene JSON from <script id=kosif-data> and animates an SVG film deterministically: stroke draw-on, text fades, polygon morphs, a stick character, pivot-rigged actors (walk/run/wave/point/sit) with a moving pen tip, per-scene camera zoom/pan and word-timed RTL captions, all through window.__kosif.seek(t) for frame-exact rendering.
when: ارسم لي مشهد سبورة بيضاء يتحرك بالقلم ومتزامن مع الكلام / Animate my SVG scene with draw-on strokes, a walking character and word-timed captions
how: embed: `python3 scripts/motion_director.py compile ./scene.json --out ./out/film.html`; seek: `window.__kosif.seek(2.5)  // in the compiled page: draws t=2.5 s, returns {time, scene, word}`; check: `node --check assets/motion_engine.js`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-engine-js`. Limits: Draws simple SVG strokes, polygon morphs and stick-figure rigs only and shows one caption word at a time. It needs a host page and a separate renderer (render_html.cjs) to become MP4, and it is not a general animation editor.
params: in: Scene JSON (validated by motion_director.py): {width, height, fps, duration, scenes:[{id, start, end, background, camera{fromZoom, toZoom, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, start, end}, words[{text, start, end}], elements[{type: path|circle|text|character|actor|morph, start, end, move{fromX, toX, fromY, toY, start, end}, ...}]}]}. It must be embedded in a page that has #kosif-data, #background, #stage, #art and #captions; #scene is looked up but not used. · out: Live SVG DOM state for each seek(t), plus window.__kosif = {duration, fps, seek, source} and window.__kosifReady (a fonts-ready promise). The engine writes no files; the embed command writes one new HTML file.
install: optional: bin:chromium, bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe, bin:node, bin:python3, npm:playwright
section: Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

what: يحوّل ملف توقيت الكلمات بصيغة motion-starter-kit (lines[].words[]) إلى لوحة قصة أصلية لـ KOSIF Motion Director بعد التحقق منها، مع معاينة HTML اختيارية يمكن الانتقال فيها إلى أي لحظة، بأنماط plotter وdoodle وwhiteboard وinfographic. — Converts motalim-ai/motion-starter-kit word-timing JSON (lines[].words[]) into a validated native KOSIF Motion Director storyboard, plus optional seekable HTML, for the plotter, doodle, whiteboard or infographic styles.
when: حوّل ملف توقيت الكلمات من motion starter kit لموشن وايت بورد / Build a doodle storyboard from my motion-starter-kit words.json
how: styles: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py styles`; demo: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py demo --style doodle --out ./out/demo-story.json --html ./out/demo-story.html`; build: `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py build --timings ./words.json --style plotter --out ./out/story.json --html ./out/story.html --fps 30`; build (estimated): `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py build --timings ./reading-estimates.json --allow-estimated --style whiteboard --out ./out/estimated-story.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-kit-bridge`. Limits: Executes only 4 of 10 upstream styles as native SVG approximations, does not render MP4, transcribe or align audio, and rejects KOSIF's flat words.json (top-level words[]).
params: in: Motion Starter Kit words.json: {duration, audio (filename or null), source, lines:[{words:[{w|word|text,start,end}]}]}; style plotter|doodle|whiteboard|infographic; fps 24/25/30/60; new output paths in existing folders. · out: JSON status on stdout; Motion Director storyboard JSON (1080x1920) and optional self-contained seekable HTML; never an MP4. Exit 2 on refusal.

what: ينشئ فيلم رسم يدوي عربي على سبورة بيضاء بصيغة SVG قابلًا للتعديل (film.html وmotion.json وREADME) مع آلية انتقال زمني حتمية، ويعرض 25 بطاقة توجيه لمحركات الحركة، ولا يصيّره إلى صورة معاينة PNG أو فيديو MP4 بمقاس 1080x1920 عبر render_html.cjs إلا عند تمرير ‎--run صراحةً. — Scaffolds an editable Arabic whiteboard-doodle SVG film (film.html + motion.json + README) with a deterministic seek contract, lists 25 motion-engine route cards, and only with explicit --run renders it to a 1080x1920 PNG preview or MP4 through render_html.cjs.
when: اعمل فيلم رسم يدوي عربي على سبورة بيضاء بالكود / Make me an editable whiteboard doodle film I can render to MP4
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py doctor`; engines: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py engines --family whiteboard`; scaffold: `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py scaffold --out ./out/film --title "قصيف يرسم" --subtitle "الحركة تُولد بالكود" --duration 8 --fps 30`; render (dry): `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py render --in ./out/film/film.html --out ./out/film/film.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-runtime`. Limits: The template is a fixed 8-second 1080x1920 whiteboard doodle performance (longer durations need hand-extended keyframes), and the render is not self-verified.
params: in: Scaffold: new output dir, title/subtitle 1–36 chars without newlines, duration 8–120 s, fps 24–60. Render: existing .html, new .mp4 or .png path, fps 24/30/60, optional audio file (MP4 only), --run to approve. · out: JSON status on stdout; project folder (film.html, motion.json, README.md); PNG preview or MP4 marked rendered_requires_visual_qa. Exit 2 on invalid request or render failure.
install: optional: bin:chromium, bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe, bin:node, npm:playwright

what: يعرض 25 تقنية حركة مسجّلة في الكتالوج، وينشئ مشاريع بداية أصلية دون تثبيت لكل من GSAP (مع Rough.js وVivus) وRemotion وManim وThree.js وPixiJS وp5.js، وتتيح مشاريع GSAP وThree.js وPixiJS وp5 الانتقال إلى أي لحظة عبر window.__kosif. — Lists 25 catalogued motion technologies and writes original, uninstalled starter projects for GSAP (+Rough.js/Vivus), Remotion, Manim, Three.js, PixiJS or p5.js; the GSAP, Three.js, PixiJS and p5 starters expose a seekable window.__kosif contract.
when: عايز مشروع بداية Three.js أو p5 للموشن / Scaffold a Remotion project for a 9:16 explainer
how: list: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py list`; doctor: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py doctor`; scaffold: `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py scaffold gsap --out ./out/kosif-gsap`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-stack`. Limits: Writes starter source only; it does not install packages, check that any engine runs, or render a video.
params: in: Backend name (gsap, remotion, manim, three, pixi, p5) and a new output directory whose parent exists; reads data/motion_sources.json. · out: JSON on stdout; a scaffold directory of original source files (package.json, index.html, src/main.js, or Remotion src/*.jsx, or Manim main.py) marked scaffold_created_not_installed. Exit 2 on refusal.
install: optional: npm:@remotion/cli, npm:gsap, npm:p5, npm:pixi.js, npm:react, npm:react-dom, npm:remotion, npm:roughjs, npm:three, npm:vite, npm:vivus, pip:manim

what: وحدة ES بلا اعتماديات تصدّر 12 دالة حركة حتمية يمكن الانتقال بها إلى أي لحظة: حصر القيم ضمن مدى، ومنحنيات التسهيل، والاستيفاء بين الإطارات المفتاحية وخطوط الزمن، وكشف خطوط SVG تدريجيًا، وتحريك الكاميرا وتكبيرها، وزوايا مفاصل دورة المشي، واختلاف المنظر (البارالاكس)، واهتزاز الخط اليدوي ببذرة ثابتة، والرمز الزمني بصيغة HH:MM:SS:FF، وحالة الترجمة على مستوى الكلمة الكاملة، والتحقق من عقد الإطارات قبل الرندر. — A dependency-free ES module that exports 12 deterministic, seekable animation primitives: clamp, easing, keyframe interpolation and timelines, SVG stroke reveal, camera pan/zoom, walk-cycle joint angles, parallax, seeded hand-drawn line jitter, HH:MM:SS:FF timecode, whole-word caption cue state and a render frame-contract check.
when: أبي دوال جاهزة للـ easing والكي فريم في الأنيميشن بتاعي / Give me deterministic easing/keyframe helpers for a seekable SVG animation
how: import: `node --input-type=module -e "import {ease, timeCode} from './resources/motion-runtime/motion_toolkit.mjs'; console.log(ease(0.5,'cubic'), timeCode(2.5,30))"`; ease: `ease(0.5, "cubic")  // 0.5; kinds: linear | smooth | in | out | cubic`; interpolate: `interpolate(2, 1, 3, 4, 8)  // 6`; timeline: `timeline(2, [{time:0,value:0},{time:1,value:10},{time:3,value:20}])  // 15`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-toolkit`. Limits: Supplies math primitives only: it draws, renders and edits nothing, and has just five easing curves and a single sine-based walk cycle.
params: in: Plain numbers and objects passed as function arguments: times in seconds, keyframe arrays [{time, value}], word cues [{word, start, end}] and option objects. · out: New plain values or objects (numbers, {strokeDasharray, strokeDashoffset}, {zoom, x, y}, point arrays, timecode strings). Invalid input throws an Error, and no files are written.

what: يصيّر فيديو B-roll حقيقيًا بحركة كاميرا (تقريب وابتعاد وتحريك جانبي) عبر FFmpeg، انطلاقًا من قائمة EDL جاهزة للإنتاج وبيان لقطات مرخّصة. ينسخ مسار الصوت الأصلي دون أي تعديل، ويتحقق من عدد الإطارات ومن تطابق بصمة الصوت. — Renders a real camera-motion B-roll video master with FFmpeg from a production-ready cinematic_cut_planner EDL and a licensed footage manifest (push-in, pull-back and pan per shot, exact frame counts), stream-copies the original audio and verifies frame count and audio bitstream hash.
when: صيّر لي فيديو B-roll بحركة كاميرا على الصوت الأصلي من غير ما يتغير / Render the EDL into a real video with slow push-ins and keep my audio bit-identical
how: render: `python3 scripts/cinematic_broll_render.py --edl ./edl.json --manifest ./clips.json --audio ./voice.wav --out ./out/master.mkv --width 1080 --height 1920`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool cinematic-broll-render`. Limits: Produces only a camera-motion B-roll master (every shot starts at its clip's first frame) with no captions, Arabic text, graphics, transitions or audio mix, and its rights checks trust the manifest's declared flags.
params: in: --edl: production_ready kosif.edl.v1 JSON from cinematic_cut_planner.py; --manifest: JSON array of clips (same fields as the planner plus sha256 and license_evidence_url or license_document; relative paths resolve against the manifest folder); --audio: the original audio master whose duration matches the EDL within 0.04 s; --out: new .mkv or .mp4; --width/--height: even values >=32 (default 1080x1920). · out: A video file (H.264 yuv420p, CRF 19) with the original audio stream copied unchanged, plus a JSON report on stdout: path, video_frames, width, height, fps, audio_codec, audio_stream_copied, audio_original_sha256, audio_packet_sha256, audio_bitstream_verified_identical, scope. Temporary shots are deleted.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يبني قائمة قرارات مونتاج (EDL) حتمية بصيغة JSON من توقيت الكلمات وبيان لقطات مرخّصة ومراجَعة: يقسّم المشاهد عند وقفات الكلام (0.6 ثانية فأكثر) أو حين يبلغ المشهد 7 ثوانٍ، ويختار لكل مشهد اللقطة الأنسب بحسب الوسوم، ويحدد حركة الكاميرا، ويسجّل النواقص بدل اختلاق لقطات. — Builds a deterministic JSON edit decision list (kosif.edl.v1) from word timings and a reviewed, licensed footage manifest: splits scenes at speech pauses of 0.6 s or more or once a scene reaches 7 s, picks the best tag-matching clip per scene, assigns camera moves and lists blockers instead of inventing footage.
when: عندي تعليق صوتي وتوقيت كلمات ولقطات مرخصة، اعمل لي خطة مونتاج / Plan which licensed B-roll clip goes under each spoken phrase
how: plan: `python3 scripts/cinematic_cut_planner.py --words ./words.json --clips ./clips.json --duration 48.5 --fps 30 --out ./out/edl.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool cinematic-cut-planner`. Limits: Plans only: it does not inspect footage pixels, transcribe, download or render anything, and matches clips purely by word/tag overlap.
params: in: --words: a bare JSON array of {word|text,start,end,emphasis?} in seconds (the bare-list output of tools/words_convert.py works; a {"words":[...]} object does not); --clips: JSON array of clips with id, path, duration, width, height, license_verified, reviewed_frames, contains_text, contains_excluded_people, is_moving_video, and tags/description; --duration: audio seconds; --fps: 24/25/30/60 (default 30); --out: JSON path. · out: EDL JSON (schema kosif.edl.v1) with video {fps,1080x1920,frame_count}, an audio lock policy, scenes (frames, spoken_text, word_ids, key_words, footage_id/path, video_trim, camera move + easing, rights_status), rejected_clips, blockers and production_ready; a one-line JSON summary on stdout.

what: يقرأ فيديو محليًا مصرّحًا به عبر ffprobe لاستخراج المدة والأبعاد ومعدل الإطارات ووجود الصوت، ويشغّل اختياريًا كشف تغيّر المشاهد عبر FFmpeg، ثم يخرج تقرير توقيت بصيغة JSON بنقاط القطع المرشّحة والمقاطع، وهو مُدخل تحتاجه أدوات المونتاج اللاحقة. — Reads an authorized local video with ffprobe (duration, size, fps, audio presence) and optionally runs ffmpeg scene-change detection, producing a JSON timing report of cut candidates and segments that downstream KOSIF edit tools require.
when: شوف الفيديو المرجعي ده فيه كام قطع وفين / Detect the cut points in this reference reel
how: metadata: `python3 scripts/motion_reference_probe.py ./in.mp4`; cuts: `python3 scripts/motion_reference_probe.py ./in.mp4 --cuts --threshold 0.35 --out ./cuts.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool motion-reference-probe`. Limits: Cut candidates are heuristic scene-change detections that can miss dissolves or fire on flashes, and it does no object, motion, speech or semantic analysis.
params: in: A local regular (non-symlink) video file of at most 300 s and 1 GB; --cuts to enable detection; --threshold strictly between 0 and 1, default 0.35; optional --out for a new JSON path whose parent exists. · out: JSON report with status 'reference_timing_observed_not_animation_reconstructed', target (absolute input path), width, height, fps_rational, duration_seconds, audio_present, cut_detection_run, cut_candidates_seconds, segments, important_limitations and next, printed to stdout or saved to --out. Errors print {status:failed,error} to stderr with exit 2.
install: needs on PATH: ffprobe · optional: bin:ffmpeg
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يحوّل تقرير القطعات المستخرج من فيديو مرجعي، مع إشارات الصوت والبصمة البصرية والمقاطع المملوكة اختياريًا، إلى مشروع Remotion جديد قابل للتعديل لم يُصيَّر بعد، بلقطات مضبوطة على مستوى الإطار وقطعات لا تقسم الكلمات، مع تقرير فحص من بوابة الجودة. — Turns a motion_reference_probe cut report (plus optional audio cues, visual fingerprint and owned replacement clips) into a new, unrendered, editable Remotion React project with frame-exact shots, word-safe cuts and a quality-gate audit.
when: عايز أعمل مونتاج بنفس إيقاع قطعات الفيديو ده بس بلقطاتي أنا / Rebuild this reference video's cut rhythm as an editable Remotion project
how: build-project: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --out ./new-edit`; build-project-with-audio-and-look: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --cues ./cues.json --visual ./reference-look.json --fps 30 --out ./new-edit`; build-project-with-owned-media: `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --cues ./cues.json --manifest ./my-assets.json --assets-dir ./my-assets --out ./new-edit`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool reference-edit-engine`. Limits: Generates source code only: it does not install Remotion, render an MP4, inspect replacement media durations or codecs, understand shot content or reproduce the reference's effects, and output is fixed at 1080x1920.
params: in: --probe: JSON from motion_reference_probe.py --cuts (required; fewer than 80 cut candidates, reference up to 300 s); optional --cues: kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON from audio_cue_mapper.py (up to 120 s, words keyed 'word' or 'text'); --visual: JSON from reference_visual_fingerprint.py of the same video; --manifest {clips:[...],audio:'...'} with --assets-dir holding owned .mp4/.mov/.webm/.m4v and .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac files; --fps 24/25/30/60 (default 30); --out: a new directory whose parent exists. Every JSON input must be a regular file under 2 MB. · out: A new unrendered Remotion project directory: package.json (remotion ^4, @remotion/cli ^4, react ^19), src/index.jsx, src/Root.jsx, src/Video.jsx, src/plan.json (schema kosif.reference-edit.v1), decision-report.json (evidence flags), quality-audit.json (creative_quality_gate result), README.md, plus public/assets/ when owned media is given; prints a one-line JSON status.
install: optional: bin:node, npm:@remotion/cli, npm:react, npm:react-dom, npm:remotion
