what: يفكّ ترميز فيديو محلي مصرّح به بدقة 64×36 وبمعدل إطارين في الثانية عبر FFmpeg، ويقيس لكل لقطة لوحة الألوان والإضاءة والتباين والتشبّع ومقدار التغيّر ومرشّحات الإزاحة التقريبية، ثم يكتب بصمة JSON يستطيع محرك المونتاج المرجعي تحويلها إلى ألوان مشاهد جديدة. — Decodes an authorized local video at 64x36 and 2 fps with ffmpeg and measures per-shot palette, luma, contrast, saturation, frame change and coarse translation candidates, writing a JSON fingerprint that reference_edit_engine can apply as new shot colors.
when: استخرج ألوان وإضاءة كل لقطة من الفيديو المرجعي / Measure the palette and brightness of each shot in this reference video
how: fingerprint-per-shot: `python3 scripts/reference_visual_fingerprint.py ./in.mp4 --probe ./cuts.json --out ./reference-look.json`; fingerprint-whole: `python3 scripts/reference_visual_fingerprint.py ./in.mp4 --out ./reference-look.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool reference-visual-fingerprint`. Limits: Measures coarse low-resolution pixel statistics only (3-bit-quantized palette, uncalibrated luma, sparse translation guesses), not accurate color grading, object or camera tracking, or semantic understanding.
params: in: A local regular (non-symlink) video of at most 120 s; optional --probe JSON from motion_reference_probe.py --cuts of the same video; --out: a new JSON path whose parent exists (never overwritten). · out: JSON (schema kosif.reference-visual-fingerprint.v1) with duration, sample_fps 2, sample_dimensions [64,36], sample_count, per-sample rows (luma, contrast, saturation_proxy, mean_rgb, change_ratio, translation) and sections (start/end, palette hex list, mean_luma, mean_contrast, saturation_proxy, change_ratio_mean, possible_translation, motion_candidate_count), exclusions, source_name, cut_report_provided and source_video_unchanged; prints a one-line status.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: ينتج ملفات JSON حتمية وغير إتلافية لمسارين من مسارات المونتاج: خطة مونتاج نصية تحوّل نطاقات الكلمات المختارة إلى مقاطع فيديو محددة بالإطارات، وعلامات مراجعة دقيقة على مستوى الإطار مع رموز زمنية (timecode) وإحداثيات بكسل اختيارية، دون أن يقرأ الوسائط أو يقصّها أو يصيّرها. — Generates deterministic, non-destructive JSON for two editor workflows: a text-based paper edit that turns selected word ranges into frame-bounded video-only segments, and frame-accurate review markers with timecodes and optional pixel anchors; it never reads, cuts or renders media.
when: عايز أقص الفيديو بالكلام: خلّي الكلمات من 1 لـ 3 ومن 7 لـ 9 / Make a text-based paper edit from words.json
how: paper-edit: `python3 scripts/video_workflow_bridge.py paper-edit templates/ik-wave-words.json --keep "1-3,5" --fps 30 --out ./out/paper-edit.json`; review: `python3 scripts/video_workflow_bridge.py review ./notes.json --duration 60 --fps 30 --width 1080 --height 1920 --out ./out/review-markers.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool video-workflow-bridge`. Limits: Produces cut and review plans only: it never cuts, renders or plays media, and its paper-edit segments must not be applied to an audio master.
params: in: paper-edit: words.json (list or {words:[...]}) with 'word'/start/end seconds, non-overlapping; --keep ranges such as '1-3,7-9'; --fps (integer, default 30). review: notes JSON list of {time,comment,x?,y?} with 0 <= time < duration and x/y in 0..1; --duration seconds; --fps; --width/--height (default 1080x1920). · out: A JSON file at --out (parent dirs created, existing file overwritten): kosif.video-paper-edit.v1 segments with source/output frames, word indices and text, or kosif.frame-review.v1 markers; prints {status,output,schema}.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يقيس ملف WAV بترميز PCM بعمق 16 بت (حتى 120 ثانية) ويُخرج ملف JSON جديدًا بصيغة kosif.audio-cues.v1 يضم غلاف طاقة RMS كل 50 ملي ثانية وبدايات صوتية مرشّحة عند ارتفاع الطاقة، ويستورد اختياريًا توقيتات كلمات جاهزة من WhisperX أو KOSIF بعد التحقق منها، دون أن يختلق سرعة إيقاع أو نبضات أو كلمات أو مشاعر. — Measures a 16-bit PCM WAV (up to 120 s) into a new kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON with a 50 ms RMS energy envelope and rising-energy onset candidates, optionally importing validated WhisperX/KOSIF word timings, without ever inventing BPM, beats, words or emotion.
when: حلّل الصوت ده وطلّع لي لحظات ارتفاع الطاقة عشان أركّب عليها القطعات / Measure onsets and energy in my voiceover WAV for motion sync
how: measure: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py ./voice.wav --out ./out/cues.json`; measure-with-words: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py ./voice.wav --aligned-words ./words.json --out ./out/cues.json`; help: `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool audio-cue-mapper`. Limits: Detects amplitude jumps only: it does not estimate tempo or beats, does not transcribe, and does not read MP3/AAC or 8/24/32-bit WAV, which must first be converted to 16-bit PCM WAV elsewhere.
params: in: An uncompressed 16-bit PCM WAV, mono or stereo, 8–192 kHz, 0.1–120 s, under 64 MB. Optionally a JSON with words[] or segments[].words[], each {word|text, start, end} in seconds, in order and inside the audio (at most 1500 words, 120 characters each). · out: A new JSON file with schema kosif.audio-cues.v1: source, duration, sample_rate, channels, window_seconds, energy_rms[], energy_median, onset_candidates_seconds[], words[{text, start, end}], word_alignment_source, bpm:null, emotion:null, verified_beats:false, scope and master_clock. It refuses to overwrite, and the parent folder must exist. A one-line JSON summary is printed on stdout; errors exit 2.

what: يحوّل ملف kosif.audio-cues.v1 إلى ملف JSON جديد يضم حتى ثلاث فرضيات متمايزة لسرعة الإيقاع (يقيّم السرعات من 60 إلى 200 نبضة في الدقيقة مقابل البدايات المقيسة)، وشبكة نبضات تقديرية عندما يبلغ أفضل تطابق 0.60 أو أكثر، وأقسام طاقة لكل ثانية مقارنةً بوسيط المقطع، مع وسم كل النتائج بأنها غير مؤكدة. — Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 file into a new JSON of up to three distinct tempo hypotheses (60–200 BPM scored against measured onsets), an estimated beat grid when the best match is at least 0.60, and per-second energy sections relative to the track median, all flagged as unverified.
when: طلّع لي البي بي إم التقريبي للمزيكا دي / Estimate the tempo and a beat grid from my measured audio cues
how: estimate: `python3 scripts/music_rhythm_engine.py ./out/cues.json --out ./out/rhythm.json`; help: `python3 scripts/music_rhythm_engine.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool music-rhythm-engine`. Limits: Gives a heuristic tempo guess from onset alignment only: half- and double-time errors are common, fewer than 4 onsets gives no tempo, and it detects no chords, mood or lyrics.
params: in: A cues JSON from audio_cue_mapper.py (schema kosif.audio-cues.v1, at most 2 MB, not a symlink): duration 0.1–120 s, strictly increasing onset_candidates_seconds (at most 600), energy_rms values in 0..1 (at most 10,000) and window_seconds (0.001–1, default 0.05). · out: A new JSON file with schema kosif.music-rhythm-hypotheses.v1: duration, source, tempo_hypotheses (up to 3, each {bpm, match, aligned_onsets, mean_error_seconds, phase_anchor_seconds}), candidate_tempo_bpm or null, estimated_grid_seconds[], measured_transients_seconds[], relative_energy_sections[{start, end, mean_rms, energy_label}], verified_bpm:false, lyric_understanding:false, emotion_detection:false and notes. It refuses to overwrite, and the parent folder must exist. A summary JSON is printed on stdout; errors exit 2.

what: يرسم شخصية ثنائية الأبعاد كاملة الجسم مكوّنة من طبقات، تمشي وتركض وتلوّح وتبتسم وترمش وتومئ برأسها وفق أزمنة أو كلمات محددة، مستخدمًا الحركية العكسية ذات العظمتين للساقين والذراعين، ويصدّرها صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG أو GIF أو MP4 بترميز H.264 مع إمكانية إرفاق الصوت الأصلي بصيغة AAC والتحقق من حزمه. — Renders a layered 2D full-body character that walks, runs, waves, smiles, blinks and nods on time or word cues, using two-bone IK for legs and arms, and exports PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4 with optional packet-verified original AAC audio.
when: خلّي الشخصية تمشي وتلوّح وتبتسم على كلمات التعليق / Animate a 2D character that walks, waves, smiles, blinks and nods
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py doctor`; render-still: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --time 1.55 --output ./still.png`; render-gif: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --fps 8 --output ./walk.gif`; render-mp4-audio: `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py render --scene templates/fullbody-demo.json --words templates/fullbody-demo-words.json --fps 24 --audio ./voice.m4a --output ./fullbody.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool character-fullbody`. Limits: One stylized 2D figure with six preset actions and simple leg/arm IK; no 3D, mocap, lip sync, transcription, multiple characters or custom artwork.
params: in: A kosif.fullbody.v1 scene JSON with: a 128-1280 px canvas; duration 0.1-30 s; character origin, scale 0.35-1.8 and colours; at most 100 actions (walk, run, wave, smile, blink, nod). Actions must be ordered by start across all channels. Each has exactly one of time or word (+occurrence), a duration of 0.05-30 s and an optional speed. Walk and run share one channel, and no two actions may overlap on the same channel. Optional --words JSON {words:[{word,start,end}]} from real alignment. Optional --audio must be AAC (MP4 only) with a length matching the duration. --fps 1-60; --time applies to stills. · out: A new PNG or SVG still, or a GIF or H.264 MP4 (CRF 19, whole frame count, at most 600 frames). Images have five layers: ground, back limbs, torso and head, facial expression, front arm. The MP4 can include the original AAC by stream copy. stdout gets JSON with verified, the output path, frames, sha256, audio_packets_preserved and the format; errors go to stderr with exit 1.
install: pip install Pillow · optional: bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe

what: يحرّك ذراع شخصية مرسومة بسيطة بالحركية العكسية التحليلية ذات العظمتين نحو أهداف تحدّدها أزمنة أو توقيتات كلمات موثّقة، ويصدّر صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG أو GIF أو MP4 بترميز H.264، مع إمكانية نسخ التعليق الصوتي الأصلي بصيغة AAC دون إعادة ترميز والتحقق منه ببصمات الحزم. — Animates a simple drawn character's arm with analytic two-bone inverse kinematics toward targets cued by time or verified word timestamps, exporting PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4, optionally with the original AAC narration stream-copied and checked by packet hashes.
when: حرّك ذراع الشخصية لما يقول كلمة ارفع / Make the character raise its arm on a specific word from my narration
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py doctor`; render-still: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --time 0.8 --output ./pose.png`; render-video: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --fps 24 --output ./wave.mp4`; render-with-audio: `python3 scripts/character_ik.py render --scene templates/ik-wave-demo.json --words templates/ik-wave-words.json --fps 24 --audio ./narration.m4a --output ./wave-voice.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool character-ik`. Limits: Animates one two-bone arm on an otherwise static simple figure; it is not full-body rigging, lip sync, transcription or AI character generation.
params: in: A kosif.ik.v1 scene JSON with: a 128-2048 px canvas; duration 0.1-30 s; a rig (shoulder, upper/lower bone lengths 5-1000, bend ±1, colours, widths); 1-100 targets, each with exactly one of time or word (+occurrence), a point and a travel time. The first target must sit at time 0 with travel 0. Optional --words JSON ({words:[{word,start,end}]} or a bare list, sorted by start, from real alignment). Optional --audio must be AAC and match the scene length (MP4 only). --fps 1-60; --time applies to stills only. · out: A new PNG or SVG still at --time, or a GIF or H.264 MP4 of the whole scene (duration×fps must be a whole number of frames, at most 600). The MP4 can carry the original AAC by stream copy. stdout gets JSON with the output path, verified, sha256, frames, fps, cue_times and audio_packet_copy_verified; errors go to stderr with exit 1.
install: pip install Pillow · optional: bin:ffmpeg, bin:ffprobe

what: يولّد لوحة قصصية (storyboard) قابلة للتحرير بصيغة JSON لأداة Motion Director بمقاس 1080×1920، مع معاينة HTML مستقلة اختيارية يمكن التنقّل فيها زمنيًا، تُرسم فيها تدريجيًا شخصيات متجهية لإنسان أو قطة أو كليهما في شارع أو حديقة، بست حركات وثلاثة تعابير وتوقيتات كلمات حقيقية اختيارية. — Generates an editable 1080x1920 Motion Director storyboard JSON, plus an optional self-contained seekable HTML preview, in which procedural vector human and/or cat characters draw on in a street or park with six actions, three moods and optional real word timestamps.
when: ارسم لي شخص وقطة يمشون في شارع كموشن جرافيك / Draw a hand-drawn style character walking down a street as an editable animation
how: generate: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast human+cat --expression happy --location street --action walk --out ./story.json --html ./story.html`; generate-with-words: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast human --action wave --duration 9 --words-json templates/ik-wave-words.json --out ./talk.json --html ./talk.html`; generate-json-only: `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast cat --expression determined --location park --action run --duration 12 --fps 30 --out ./cat-park.json`; library: `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import code_drawing_master as d; print(len(d.human_parts('happy')), len(d.cat_parts('sad')))"`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool code-drawing-master`. Limits: Produces a fixed, stylized procedural storyboard (two locations, preset human/cat rigs, six actions) and only compiles HTML; it does not render MP4, transcribe speech, lip-sync or accept custom artwork.
params: in: CLI choices only: --cast human|cat|human+cat (default human+cat); --expression happy|sad|determined; --location street|park; --action idle|walk|run|wave|point|sit; --duration 4-120 s (default 9); --fps 24|25|30|60. Optional --words-json takes pre-aligned timestamps (words[] or WhisperX segments[].words, at most 240 words, UTF-8 without a BOM); they must be non-overlapping and inside the duration, and words without start/end are refused. --out (required) and --html must be new paths in existing directories. · out: A new Motion Director v1 storyboard JSON at --out: one 1080x1920 scene with draw-on street or park paths, a fixed 'KOSIF DRAWING' title, a polygon morph, articulated actors (20-part human, 14-part cat) with post-draw movement, a camera zoom and the words. Optional --html adds a self-contained seekable HTML that embeds assets/motion_engine.js. A JSON report goes to stdout with rendered:false; failures print {status:failed} to stderr with exit 2.

what: يرسم مشهدًا من طبقات معرّفًا بصيغة JSON صارمة (مستطيلات وأشكال بيضاوية وخطوط ومضلعات وضربات فرشاة حساسة للضغط ونصوص) باستخدام Pillow ويصدّره صورًا ثابتة PNG أو SVG، أو يحرّك الطبقات كاملةً بإطارات مفتاحية ويصدّرها GIF أو MP4 بترميز H.264. — Paints a strict JSON layered scene (rectangles, ellipses, lines, polygons, pressure brush strokes, text) with Pillow into PNG/SVG stills, or animates whole layers with keyframes into a GIF or H.264 MP4.
when: ارسم لوحة بطبقات وصدّرها PNG وSVG / Paint a layered illustration from JSON and export PNG and SVG
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py doctor`; render: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py render --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.png --time 0.5`; render-svg: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py render --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.svg`; animate-gif: `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py animate --scene templates/creative-paint-demo.json --output ./paint.gif --fps 12 --duration 2`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-paint`. Limits: A simple 2D primitive painter with whole-layer keyframes only (no AI generation, per-shape animation or PSD); SVG drops brush pressure and blend modes, and rotated layers do not land in the same place in PNG and SVG.
params: in: A kosif.paint.v1 JSON scene (UTF-8 without a BOM) with: integer width/height 1-2048; background as #RRGGBB[AA] or 'transparent'; 1-150 layers (name, opacity, blend normal|multiply|screen, visible); at most 1500 shapes in total. Shape kinds are rectangle, ellipse, line, polygon, brush ([x,y,pressure] points, 2-1500) and text (optional font file path). Optional per-layer keyframes (up to 100) set x/y/angle/scale/opacity with linear or ease-in-out. render takes --time 0-3600 s; animate takes --fps 1-60 and --duration up to 30 s, with ceil(fps×duration) at most 300 frames. · out: render writes a new .png or .svg; animate writes a new .gif, or a .mp4 (H.264, CRF 18) via ffmpeg. stdout gets JSON with the output path, sha256, bytes or fps/frames, and a verified flag; errors go to stderr as {verified:false,error} with exit 1. Existing outputs are never overwritten.

what: يحوّل ضربات الرسم الحر المعرّفة بصيغة JSON إلى رسمة من طبقات، ويطابق كل ضربة اختياريًا مع مستطيل أو شكل بيضاوي أو خط مستقيم بهندسة حتمية، ثم يعرض الأشكال المتعرَّف عليها أو يصدّر الرسمة بصيغة PNG أو SVG. — Turns freehand stroke JSON into a layered drawing, optionally snapping each stroke to a rectangle, ellipse or straight line with deterministic geometry, then reports the recognized shapes or renders the drawing to PNG/SVG.
when: حوّل خربشاتي إلى مستطيل ودائرة وخط مستقيم / Snap my rough freehand strokes into clean shapes
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py doctor`; analyze: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py analyze --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json`; render-svg: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py render --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json --output ./sketch.svg`; render-png: `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py render --scene templates/smart-draw-demo.json --output ./sketch.png`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool smart-draw`. Limits: Heuristic geometric snapping into three shape classes plus freehand (rectangle, ellipse, line); no ML object recognition like AutoDraw, no eraser, collaboration or template library.
params: in: A kosif.smartdraw.v1 JSON with: integer width/height 128-2048; background #RRGGBB[AA] or 'transparent'; 1-100 strokes. Each stroke has 2-1500 [x,y,pressure?] points inside the canvas (pressure 0.1-5), a color #RRGGBB[AA], a width of 1-80, a brush of pen, marker or highlighter, and assist true or false (default false). Only strokes with assist:true are classified. · out: analyze prints JSON {recognized:[{stroke,recognized,brush}],layers} to stdout. render also writes a new .png or .svg, one layer per stroke (highlighter at opacity 0.32, marker at 0.9), and adds the output path and byte count. Existing files are never overwritten.

what: يجري جردًا ساكنًا للقراءة فقط لمجلد محلي دون تشغيل أي شيء، ويعيد تقرير JSON يتضمّن أعداد الملفات وامتداداتها وتصنيف وجهتها (مراجعة الشيفرة، أو ملفات ثنائية مرشّحة للتحليل بـ Ghidra أو REA، أو أرشيفات، أو وسائط) ومؤشرات مطابقة الأنماط وبصمات SHA-256 وإحصاءات أمان ملفات zip. — Performs a read-only static inventory of a local folder without executing anything and returns a JSON report of file counts, extensions, routes (source review, Ghidra/REA binary candidates, archives, media), regex indicators, SHA-256 hashes and zip-safety stats.
when: افحص مجلد المشروع هذا وقل لي محتواه بدون تشغيل أي شيء / Do a read-only triage of this local project folder
how: scan: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py ./my-project`; scan-with-report: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py ./my-project --output ./audit/report.json --limit 20000`; library: `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import local_project_audit as a; print(a.scan('templates')['routes'])"`; help: `python3 scripts/local_project_audit.py --help`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool local-project-audit`. Limits: Static, file-level triage by extension and regex signatures only; it never executes or extracts anything and cannot prove runtime behavior, malware status or licensing.
params: in: A local directory path (positional root). Optional --output gives a report path outside that directory. Optional --limit sets the maximum number of files, 1-1,000,000 (default 100000). · out: A one-line JSON summary on stdout (schema kosif.local-project-audit.v1, without samples or skipped items). With --output, the full report also holds up to 120 sample records: the first 80 files plus every Ghidra/REA candidate. Each record has the path, bytes, route, sha256 for files up to 4 MB, regex indicators for source files up to 2 MB, and zip entries, uncompressed bytes, ratio and unsafe_path_count. The report also lists up to 30 skipped entries.

what: يفحص كل سجل قدرة في data/powers/*.json دون تشغيل أي شيء، بحثًا عن المعرّفات المكررة والسجلات المعطوبة ومدى تغطية روابط الإثبات. ويكتفي بالتحقق من وجود المراجع المحلية 'kosif-tool/...'، ويُحصي الحالات ونطاقات الإثبات المعلنة. — Statically audits every power record in data/powers/*.json for duplicate ids, malformed records and proof-link coverage. It checks only whether local 'kosif-tool/...' references exist and counts the claimed statuses and proof scopes.
when: افحص كتالوج القدرات وشوف فيه سجلات مكررة أو روابط إثبات ناقصة / audit the powers catalog for duplicate ids and broken proof links
how: audit: `python3 scripts/catalog_evidence_audit.py`; --skill: `python3 scripts/catalog_evidence_audit.py --skill .`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool catalog-evidence-audit`. Limits: Checks only that local reference paths exist, never runs a capability, and leaves every URL, sibling-repo or archive reference unverified, so a clean report does not prove that anything works.
params: in: Optional --skill path to a skill folder that contains data/powers/*.json (defaults to this skill). · out: JSON report on stdout. Exit 0 when there are no record integrity errors, 1 otherwise (a missing local reference does not change the exit code). A folder with no catalog crashes with a ValueError traceback, also exit 1.

what: يبني خريطة واحدة مترابطة للمهارة: الجذر ← المجالات ← العائلات ← المستلزمات التي تحتاجها، والسكربتات التي تنفّذها، والاختبارات التي تذكر تلك السكربتات. تأتي روابط الكود من تحليل محلي لعبارات الاستيراد عبر شجرة الصياغة المجرّدة (AST)، مدموجًا مع لقطة Graphify المحفوظة في المستودع. تُكتب الخريطة في data/capability_graph.json مع صفحة HTML قابلة للبحث تعمل دون اتصال، وتجيب الأداة عن استعلامات الإحصاء والعُقد المجاورة. — Builds one connected graph of the skill: root → domains → families → the requirements they need, the scripts that run them, and the tests that mention those scripts. Code edges come from a local AST import pass merged with the committed Graphify snapshot. The graph is written as data/capability_graph.json plus an offline, searchable HTML page, and the tool answers stats and neighbour queries on it.
when: ورّيني خريطة القدرات المترابطة للمهارة / show me the capability graph of the skill
how: build: `python3 scripts/capability_graph.py build`; build --check: `python3 scripts/capability_graph.py build --check`; build --out-dir: `python3 scripts/capability_graph.py build --out-dir ./out/`; stats: `python3 scripts/capability_graph.py stats`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool capability-graph`. Limits: Edges are inferred from text mentions (script paths in how/proof fields, file names inside tests) and import statements, so 'tested_by' means a test names the script, not that it passed; stats and path read the committed JSON, which may be stale.
params: in: data/powers/*.json, data/requirements.json, data/graphify_code_layer.json (a local snapshot; no network), the scripts/ sources (AST), and tests/*.py plus evals/*.py|*.mjs (scanned for script file names). path takes one key. · out: data/capability_graph.json (nodes and edges) and references/capability-graph.html (self-contained, no CDN, light and dark themes), or both files in --out-dir. Plus one-line build summaries, stats Counters or path edge listings on stdout.
section: Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

what: يدقّق ملف خطة مونتاج مرجعي من KOSIF ‏(plan.json بمخطط kosif.reference-edit.v1). يتحقق من اتساق ساعة الإطارات، ومن تتابع اللقطات بلا فجوات ولا تداخل، ومن أن نبضات الإيقاع داخل حدود لقطاتها، ومن أنه لا توجد كلمة موقّتة تعبر قطعًا حادًا، ومن سلامة أسماء ملفات الوسائط المحلية (ومن وجودها فعلًا إن أُعطي مشروع Remotion)، ومن صدق مؤشرات الإثبات. ثم يكتب تقرير تدقيق JSON جديدًا حالته إما structurally_verified_render_pending (سليم بنيويًا وبانتظار التصيير) أو blocked (محجوب). — Audits a KOSIF reference-edit plan.json (schema kosif.reference-edit.v1). It checks the fps/frame clock, gap-free and overlap-free shot frames, bounded pulse cues, that no aligned word crosses a hard cut, safe local media names (and, with an optional Remotion project, that those files exist), and honest evidence flags. It writes a new audit JSON whose status is structurally_verified_render_pending or blocked.
when: افحص خطة المونتاج دي قبل الريندر: فيه فجوات بين اللقطات؟ / Run the quality gate on my Remotion reference-edit plan
how: audit: `python3 scripts/creative_quality_gate.py ./my-project/src/plan.json --out ./out/quality-audit.json`; audit-with-project: `python3 scripts/creative_quality_gate.py ./my-project/src/plan.json --project-dir ./my-project --out ./out/quality-audit.json`; inspect_plan (import): `python3 -c "import sys,json; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import creative_quality_gate as q; print(q.inspect_plan(json.load(open('./plan.json')))['status'])"`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-quality-gate`. Limits: It checks only the plan's structure and timing logic; it never renders or inspects the MP4's visuals, audio sync, rights or aesthetic quality.
params: in: plan.json of schema kosif.reference-edit.v1 (made by scripts/reference_edit_engine.py, stored at <project>/src/plan.json). It must be a regular file, not a symlink, ≤2 MB, with duration 0.1–300 s, fps 24/25/30/60, totalFrames ≤18000, 1–80 shots and an alignedWords list (it may be empty, but a missing list blocks the word gate; at most 1500 entries). Optionally the generated Remotion project directory. · out: A new audit JSON (checks with pass/detail, failures, metrics such as shots/totalFrames/shortShotsUnderQuarterSecond/replacementAssetSlots, and an 'unverified' list) plus a one-line JSON summary on stdout. Exit 0 = structurally_verified_render_pending; exit 2 = blocked, invalid input or a bad --out path.
section: Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

what: يحلّل كل ملفات ‎.py في مجلد سكربتات Blender أو إضافاته أو شيفرته المصدرية تحليلًا ثابتًا بوحدة ast في بايثون، دون استيراد أي ملف أو تشغيله. يعدّ أصناف Operator وPanel وMenu وPropertyGroup وGizmoGroup من bpy.types واستدعاءات bpy.ops، ويصنّف الملفات في مجموعات موضوعية حسب أسمائها، ثم يطبع ملخصًا بصيغة JSON. — Statically parses every .py file under a Blender scripts, addon or source folder with Python's ast module, without importing or running anything. It counts bpy.types Operator, Panel, Menu, PropertyGroup and GizmoGroup classes, bpy.ops calls and topic groups by file name, and prints a JSON summary.
when: افحص سكربتات بايثون اللي مع Blender من غير ما تشغّلها / What bpy operators does this Blender addon folder call?
how: --help: `python3 scripts/blender_api_audit.py --help`; audit: `python3 scripts/blender_api_audit.py ./blender-scripts/`; audit --output: `python3 scripts/blender_api_audit.py ./blender-scripts/ --output ./out/blender_api_audit.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool blender-api-audit`. Limits: It produces static AST counts of bpy classes and bpy.ops calls in .py files only (at most 3,000 files); it does not run Blender, read C/C++ or prove runtime behaviour, and its topic counts are file-name substring heuristics.
params: in: A directory of Blender Python sources (an installed Blender's scripts folder, an addon folder or a source checkout). Optional --output path for the full JSON report. · out: JSON on stdout (schema kosif.blender-api-audit.v1): files found and parsed, skipped files, counts of operator class types, topic file counts, source_not_executed=true and a caveat. With --output, a JSON file that also holds samples and the bpy_ops_calls counts.

what: يتحقق من مشهد JSON محدود بصيغة kosif.blender.v1، ثم يشغّل Blender المثبّت مسبقًا لدى المستخدم في الخلفية (بإعدادات المصنع ومع تعطيل التنفيذ التلقائي) عبر blender_worker.py لإنتاج صورة PNG أو ملف ‎.blend قابل للتعديل أو ملف ‎.glb متحرك، أما الأمر doctor فيكتفي باكتشاف Blender. — Validates a bounded kosif.blender.v1 JSON scene and, when the user already has Blender installed, runs it headless (factory startup, autoexec disabled) through blender_worker.py to produce a PNG still, an editable .blend or an animated .glb; doctor only detects Blender.
when: عندي Blender متثبت، اعمل منه رندر PNG للمشهد ده / render this JSON scene with my installed Blender to a .blend or .glb
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/blender_bridge.py doctor`; render (GLB): `python3 scripts/blender_bridge.py render --scene templates/blender-demo.json --output ./out/scene.glb`; render (.blend): `python3 scripts/blender_bridge.py render --scene templates/blender-demo.json --output ./out/scene.blend`; render (PNG, explicit Blender): `python3 scripts/blender_bridge.py render --scene templates/blender-demo.json --output ./out/still.png --blender /opt/blender/blender`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool blender-bridge`. Limits: Fixed camera, one area light and location-only keyframes on primitives; doctor only detects Blender, and the repo records no real Blender render through this bridge.
params: in: kosif.blender.v1 JSON: size 128–1920, fps 1–60, frames 1–240, 1–12 objects (cube, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus) with location (±100), scale (±20), RGBA colour 0–1 and ≤24 ordered location keyframes; --output a new .png/.blend/.glb in an existing folder; optional --blender path to an existing executable file. · out: The requested .png/.blend/.glb file plus one JSON line {executed, verified_file, engine, format, bytes, sha256, object_count, output}; doctor prints {blender_installed, path, formats, user_code_loaded:false, automatically_installs:false, render_verified:false}; errors as JSON {executed:false, error} on stderr with exit 1.

name_ar: رندر Cycles إلى فيديو مُتحقَّق منه
what: يُجري رندرًا لمشهد موجود (‎.blend أو ‎.glb أو ‎.gltf) بمحرك Cycles في Blender مع إزالة الضوضاء ومظهر AgX إلى إطارات PNG، ثم يرمّزها فيديو H.264 بصيغة MP4 أو MKV عبر FFmpeg، ويتحقق من الأبعاد وعدد الإطارات بـFFprobe ويكتب تقرير render-report.json؛ أما الأمر plan فيطبع خطة العمل وبصمة SHA-256 للمصدر دون رندر. — Renders an existing .blend/.glb/.gltf scene with Blender Cycles (denoised, AgX) to PNG frames, encodes them to an H.264 MP4/MKV with FFmpeg, checks size and frame count with FFprobe and writes a render-report.json; plan prints the job and the source SHA-256 without rendering.
when: رندر ملف .blend بتاعي لفيديو MP4 بـCycles واتأكد من عدد الفريمات / render my .blend scene to a verified MP4 with Cycles
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/blender_cycles_render.py doctor`; plan: `python3 scripts/blender_cycles_render.py plan --scene ../../../proofs/blender-cat-rescue-20261019/cat_rescue_5s_editable.blend --out ./out/render.mp4 --frames 150 --fps 30 --width 540 --height 960 --samples 24`; render: `python3 scripts/blender_cycles_render.py render --scene ./scene.glb --out ./out/render.mp4 --frames 48 --fps 24 --width 640 --height 360 --samples 24 --device CPU`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool blender-cycles-render`. Limits: Renders only what the scene already contains (adding at most a default camera and one area light), so it cannot make a scene realistic, and its frame-count check is skipped for .mkv output.
params: in: --scene an existing .blend/.glb/.gltf (glTF is imported into an emptied factory scene), --out a new .mp4/.mkv path, --frames 1–3600 (default 150), --fps 1–120 (default 30), --width/--height even 64–4096 (default 640x360), --samples 4–512 (default 24), --device CPU|GPU, optional --blender/--ffmpeg/--ffprobe paths or names. · out: Verified video at --out plus <stem>.render-report.json (source and video SHA-256, probe data, settings); stdout {video, report, status:VERIFIED_VIDEO}; doctor and plan print JSON only; failures print {error, status:FAILED} on stderr with exit 2 (argparse errors also exit 2).
install: needs on PATH: blender, ffmpeg, ffprobe

what: سكربت يعمل داخل Blender المحلي فقط ويستدعيه blender_bridge.py عادةً، فيعيد التحقق من مشهد kosif.blender.v1 ويبني الأشكال الأساسية وخامات Principled والإطارات المفتاحية للموضع والكاميرا والإضاءة، ثم يحفظ صورة PNG أو ملف ‎.blend أو ملف ‎.glb متحركًا. — Blender-side script, run only inside a local Blender (normally by blender_bridge.py), that re-validates the kosif.blender.v1 JSON and builds primitive meshes, Principled materials, location keyframes, a camera and an area light, then saves a PNG still, a .blend or an animated .glb.
when: إيه السكربت اللي بيشتغل جوّه Blender لبناء المشهد؟ / what script does Blender execute for the KOSIF bridge
how: run inside Blender: `blender --background --factory-startup --disable-autoexec --python-exit-code 3 --python scripts/blender_worker.py -- templates/blender-demo.json ./out/scene.glb`; via bridge (preferred): `python3 scripts/blender_bridge.py render --scene templates/blender-demo.json --output ./out/scene.blend`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool blender-worker`. Limits: Only works inside Blender (bpy/mathutils), with a fixed camera at (8,-12,9), one area light and location-only keyframes, and it has never been executed in this repo's recorded tests.
params: in: Two positional paths after '--' in Blender's argv: a kosif.blender.v1 scene JSON and an output path ending in .png, .blend or .glb. · out: The output file (PNG still via Blender's default engine, saved .blend, or GLB with animations) and a stdout line KOSIF_BLENDER_OUTPUT <bytes>; raises inside Blender on invalid input or missing output.

name_ar: رندر ثلاثي الأبعاد مستقل عن Blender
what: يرسم مشهدًا ثلاثي الأبعاد مكتوبًا بصيغة JSON ‏(kosif.native3d.v1) ضمن حدود ثابتة، مؤلفًا من أشكال أساسية بتظليل مسطح (مكعب وكرة وأسطوانة ومخروط وحلقة) مع إطارات مفتاحية للموضع والدوران حول المحور الرأسي وكاميرا بإسقاط متعامد، ويُخرجه صورة PNG أو فيديو MP4 بترميز H.264 باستخدام Python وPillow (وFFmpeg للفيديو) دون Blender. — Renders a bounded kosif.native3d.v1 JSON scene of flat-shaded primitives (cube, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus) with location/yaw keyframes and an orthographic camera to a PNG frame or an H.264 MP4, using pure Python + Pillow (FFmpeg for MP4) and no Blender.
when: اعمل لي أنيميشن 3D بسيط لمكعب وكرة من غير Blender / render a simple 3D primitives animation to MP4 without Blender
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/native_3d.py doctor`; render (PNG still): `python3 scripts/native_3d.py render --scene templates/native-3d-demo.json --output ./out/frame.png --frame 60`; render (MP4): `python3 scripts/native_3d.py render --scene templates/native-3d-primitives-demo.json --output ./out/primitives.mp4`; render (z-buffer mode): `python3 scripts/native_3d.py render --scene templates/native-zbuffer-demo.json --output ./out/depth.png`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool native-3d`. Limits: Flat-shaded orthographic primitives only: no perspective camera, textures, materials, shadows, imported meshes or Blender parity, and the pure-Python z-buffer slows down at large sizes.
params: in: kosif.native3d.v1 JSON scene: width/height 128–1280, fps 1–60, frames 1–240, background hex colour, render_mode painter|zbuffer, camera {position, target, ortho_scale 1–50}, 1–60 objects {shape cube|sphere|cylinder|cone|torus, location, scale, hex color, yaw, ≤32 strictly ordered keyframes with frame/location/yaw}; --output a new .png or .mp4 in an existing folder. · out: A new .png (one frame) or .mp4 (H.264, all frames) at --output; refuses to overwrite and the folder must already exist; stdout JSON {renderer, uses_blender:false, output, frames, bytes, sha256}; errors as JSON {ok:false, error} on stderr with exit 1.

what: يحوّل مشهد JSON محدودًا بصيغة kosif.blender.v1 (مكعب أو كرة بلون RGBA وموضع وحجم وإطارات مفتاحية خطية للموضع) إلى ملف glTF 2.0 ثنائي بامتداد ‎.glb باستخدام مكتبة Python القياسية وحدها ودون Blender. — Writes a bounded kosif.blender.v1 JSON scene (cube/sphere, RGBA colour, location, scale, linear position keyframes) to a binary glTF 2.0 .glb file using only the Python standard library, with no Blender.
when: عايز أصدّر مشهد 3D بسيط كملف GLB من غير ما أنزّل Blender / export a simple animated cube/sphere scene to .glb without Blender
how: export: `python3 scripts/native_glb.py --scene templates/blender-demo.json --output ./out/scene.glb`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool native-glb`. Limits: Exports cube and sphere geometry with translation animation only (no normals/UVs/textures, rotation or scale animation, cameras, lights or rendering) and copies the scene's Blender-style Z-up coordinates into Y-up glTF without conversion.
params: in: kosif.blender.v1 JSON (same schema as blender_bridge): 1–12 objects with shape cube or sphere, color RGBA 0–1, location (±100), scale (±20), ≤24 ordered keyframes each with frame and location; fps 1–60, frames 1–240, size metadata 128–1920; --output a new .glb path in an existing folder. · out: A new .glb file (glTF 2.0 binary with JSON + BIN chunks) at --output; stdout JSON {engine, path, bytes, sha256}; byte-identical output for identical input; a non-.glb or existing output is an argparse error (exit 2), other failures are Python tracebacks (exit 1).

what: يفحص خصائص OpenType لخط مرخّص: تغطية أحرف العبارة، وجداول GSUB وGPOS، والمحاور المتغيرة، واسم العائلة. ويرتّب مجلدًا من خطوط TTF/OTF مقارنةً بقصاصة دقيقة لنص مرجعي، إذ يرسم العبارة نفسها بتشكيل libraqm ويحسب نسبة تقاطع الأقنعة إلى اتحادها (IoU) بعد توحيد المقاس. والناتج قائمة مرشحين بصيغة JSON، لا ادعاء بتحديد الخط. — Inspects a licensed font's OpenType facts: cmap coverage of a phrase, GSUB/GPOS, variable axes and family name. It also ranks a folder of TTF/OTF fonts against a tight crop of reference text by rendering the same phrase with libraqm shaping and scoring normalized mask IoU. The output is JSON candidates, never a claimed identification.
when: إيه أقرب خط للكتابة اللي في الصورة دي؟ / Rank my licensed fonts against this cropped Arabic title
how: inspect: `python3 scripts/font_fidelity_lab.py inspect proofs/_shared/fonts/Amiri-Regular.ttf --text "جمعة مباركة"`; rank: `python3 scripts/font_fidelity_lab.py rank ./crop.png --text "جمعة مباركة" --fonts proofs/_shared/fonts --top 5`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool font-fidelity-lab`. Limits: It ranks how closely each candidate renders one phrase (binary mask IoU at 5 fixed sizes) and does not identify an unknown proprietary typeface or prove an exact match.
params: in: inspect: a font file the user is licensed to use, plus a phrase. rank: a tightly cropped image of the reference text, the exact phrase, and a folder of licensed .ttf/.otf fonts. · out: JSON on stdout only (inspection, or ranking with metric and limitations notes). Exit 2 with 'FONT FIDELITY ERROR' on a wrong extension or missing file/folder.
install: pip install Pillow · optional: pip:brotli, pip:fonttools
section: Image, design and fonts / الصور والتصميم والخطوط

what: يقرأ فهرس KOSIF Atlas المحلي لمهارات الجهات الخارجية (مع فهرس اختياري للمهارات ذات تراخيص الحقوق المتروكة copyleft)، ويطبع إحصاءات أو نتائج مرتبة بالكلمات المفتاحية مع نطاق الترخيص وعلامات الخطر وحكم المراجعة؛ ومع الخيار --skill-root يقرأ أيضًا عناوين ملف SKILL.md لكل نتيجة. ولا يشغّل أي شيء. — Reads a local KOSIF Atlas index of third-party skills (plus an optional copyleft index) and prints stats or keyword-ranked matches with licence scope, risk flags and verdicts; with --skill-root it also reads each match's SKILL.md headings. It never executes anything.
when: دوّر في أطلس المهارات على مهارة رندر بلندر / search the Atlas index for Blender rendering skills
how: stats: `python3 scripts/atlas_external_bridge.py stats --index ./atlas_index.json --copyleft-index ./atlas_copyleft_index.json`; search: `python3 scripts/atlas_external_bridge.py search --index ./atlas_index.json --query "Blender render" --top 10 --skill-root ./atlas_skills/`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool atlas-external-bridge`. Limits: Needs an external Atlas index JSON that this repo does not ship. It only ranks metadata (optionally reading SKILL.md headings) and never runs, installs or vets the listed skills.
params: in: stats|search; --index path to an Atlas index JSON (a list or {"skills":[...]}), or the KOSIF_ATLAS_INDEX env var; optional --copyleft-index; --query (required for search); --top (1–100, default 20); optional --skill-root folder holding the skills' files. · out: JSON on stdout: entry/scope/licence/verdict/domain counts and a risk-flag count, or matches with licence_scope, risk_flags, verdict, heuristic category, inspection (NOT_READ, READ_ONLY+headings, INVALID_PATH, SKILL_MD_MISSING, SKILL_MD_TOO_LARGE) and execution NOT_EXECUTED. An unreadable or malformed index exits 2 with {"error": ...} on stderr.

what: يدقّق، دون تشغيل أي كود، فهرس مهارات KOSIF Atlas وفهرسه المرافق للمهارات ذات تراخيص الحقوق المتروكة (copyleft)، بحثًا عن مشكلات البنية والعدد والمعرّفات والحقول الإلزامية، ويعدّ السجلات التي لا يكون مصدرها رابط https. ويطبع تقرير JSON عن تسميات التراخيص والأحكام ونطاقات المصادر والأخطاء البنيوية، ويمكنه أيضًا حفظه في ملف جديد. — Statically audits a KOSIF Atlas skill index and its copyleft companion for schema, count, ID and required-field problems, and counts records whose source is not an https URL. It prints a JSON report of licence labels, verdicts, source hosts and structural errors, and can also save it to a new file.
when: افحص فهرس الأطلس وتأكد إن مفيش أخطاء في البنية / audit the Atlas index metadata before importing any skills
how: audit: `python3 scripts/atlas_metadata_audit.py --index ./atlas_index.json --copyleft ./atlas_copyleft_index.json --output ./out/atlas_audit.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool atlas-metadata-audit`. Limits: Checks index structure, labels, source URLs and verdict counts only; it does not read skill source code or verify licences, safety or behaviour.
params: in: --index and --copyleft: Atlas JSON files shaped {"count": N, "skills": [...]}, both required; optional --output path to a new file in an existing folder. · out: JSON report on stdout (and in --output if given) with record counts, licence labels, verdicts, inventory counts (including missing_verified_source_url), top-15 source hosts, up to 40 structural errors and up to 12 source-URL problem samples; exit 1 if there are structural errors, the input is invalid, or --output already exists.

what: يعرض 26 هدفًا منتقًى عبر HTTPS ويفحص سجلاتها، منها تطبيقات رسم على الويب وأدوات ثلاثية الأبعاد ورسوم متحركة ومنتجات ذكاء اصطناعي ومتصفحات، من الملف data/integration-target-atlas.json. ويستطيع أن يلتقط، دون أي تفاعل، صورةً لإطار العرض في هدف واحد داخل سياق Playwright جديد بلا واجهة، يحجب الطلبات إلى النطاقات الأخرى والتنزيلات وعمّال الخدمة (service workers) ولا يحفظ ملفات تعريف الارتباط. — Lists and inspects 26 curated HTTPS targets (web drawing apps, 3D and animation tools, AI and browser products) from data/integration-target-atlas.json. It can take a read-only viewport screenshot of one target in a fresh headless Playwright context that blocks off-host requests, downloads, service workers and saved cookies.
when: صوّر لي واجهة Photopea عشان أدرس ميزاتها / Which web drawing apps are in the integration target atlas?
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/browser_scout.py doctor`; list: `python3 scripts/browser_scout.py list`; inspect: `python3 scripts/browser_scout.py inspect autodraw`; capture: `python3 scripts/browser_scout.py capture autodraw --output ./out/autodraw.png --engine chromium`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool browser-scout`. Limits: It captures only a viewport screenshot of one of 26 curated HTTPS targets (no arbitrary URLs, logins, clicks or crawling), and because off-host requests are blocked, pages that load assets from CDNs may render incomplete.
params: in: A target id from data/integration-target-atlas.json. For capture: --output, the path of an unused .png in an existing folder, and --engine chromium, firefox or webkit. · out: JSON on stdout: doctor status, the target list or one target record. capture writes one PNG screenshot and prints its metadata (HTTP status, title, sha256, bytes, cookies_saved=false).

what: يبحث بالكلمات المفتاحية في فهرس محلي يضم 1,000 مستودع عام على GitHub (تحرير الفيديو ومعالجته، والموشن جرافيك، وأدوات الصور، والرؤية الحاسوبية، والبرمجة الإبداعية) و1,000 موقع إبداعي مستخرَج من قوائم awesome منتقاة (أدوات التصميم، والموشن جرافيك، وأدوات الصور بالذكاء الاصطناعي، والبرمجة الإبداعية، وإنتاج الفيديو)، ويطبع نتائج JSON مرتبة موسومة بأنها بيانات وصفية فقط. — Keyword-searches an offline index of 1,000 public GitHub repositories (video editing and processing, motion graphics, image and photo tools, computer vision, creative coding) and 1,000 creative websites extracted from curated awesome lists (design tools, motion graphics, AI image tools, creative coding, video production), and prints ranked JSON matches labelled metadata-only.
when: دورلي على أدوات مفتوحة المصدر للمونتاج وإزالة الخلفية / find open-source repos for kinetic typography
how: search: `python3 scripts/creative_external_search.py search "kinetic typography" --kind repo --top 5`; stats: `python3 scripts/creative_external_search.py stats`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool creative-external-search`. Limits: Plain substring keyword scoring over a frozen offline index of public metadata and curated links; no entry was code-analysed, licence-verified, checked for availability or tested, and nothing is fetched live.
params: in: search|stats, a query in English or Arabic (required for search), --kind all|repo|site, --top; reads data/rea-creative-research/public_repos.json and creative_websites.json. · out: JSON on stdout with ensure_ascii (non-Latin text appears as \u escapes). Repo items carry name, url, summary, category, stars, SPDX licence metadata and discovery query; site items carry hostname, sample url, topic and source list; every item has rea_analysis, feature_status (DISCOVERED_METADATA_ONLY / CURATED_LINK_ONLY) and relevance_score. stats prints repo/site counts and repo category counts.

what: يعرض فهرسًا ثابتًا من 100 موقع للوسائط الجاهزة والمجموعات المفتوحة والخامات ويبحث فيه، ويطبع المتطلبات القانونية لأي رابط. ولا ينزّل أي ملف عبر fetch_video.py إلا بعد تقديم إثبات صريح لحقوق ذلك الملف بعينه، ويسجّل كل تنزيل مع بصمته SHA-256 وحقوقه في ملف asset_rights.jsonl. — Lists and searches a fixed catalog of 100 stock, open-collection and texture websites and prints the legal prerequisites for a URL. It downloads a single asset through fetch_video.py only after explicit per-asset rights evidence is supplied, and records each download with its SHA-256 and rights in asset_rights.jsonl.
when: فين ألاقي لقطات ستوك مجانية للمونتاج؟ / Find free stock video sites for B-roll
how: list: `python3 scripts/media_sources.py list`; search: `python3 scripts/media_sources.py search pexels --type video_image`; plan: `python3 scripts/media_sources.py plan https://www.pexels.com/video/123/`; download-dry-run: `python3 scripts/media_sources.py download https://www.pexels.com/video/123/ --rights stock-license --evidence-url https://www.pexels.com/license/ --credit "Pexels" -o ./out/media --dry-run`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool media-sources`. Limits: The rights check only confirms that evidence fields were supplied in the right shape; it does not open or verify the license page, grants no license, and real downloads need yt-dlp, which is missing here.
params: in: The built-in catalog data/media_sources_100.json. For plan or download: a media or page URL. For download: --rights (owned|cc0|public-domain|cc-by|cc-by-sa|stock-license|direct-permission). An HTTPS --evidence-url is required unless the rights are owned, --creator and --credit are required for CC BY/SA, and --credit is required for stock-license. Optional --site (catalog domain for CDN URLs), --quality (best/2160/1080/720/480/audio) and -o (default ./media_assets). · out: Text lists, plan JSON or dry-run JSON on stdout. download writes the media plus manifest.json via fetch_video.py into --out, then appends asset_rights.jsonl. Exit 2 means a rights or --site check failed; a failed download returns fetch_video's exit code or 1.

what: يبني فهارس الاكتشاف الإبداعي باستعلام GitHub عبر أداة gh: بحث المستودعات حسب الموضوع، واستخراج روابط المواقع من ملفات README لقوائم awesome منتقاة، وجرد مستودعات المالك وبيانات أشجارها في git. ويطبع ملخصًا بصيغة JSON في كل تشغيل، والأمر report وحده يعمل دون اتصال فيكتفي بعدّ الفهارس الموجودة. — Builds the creative discovery catalogs by querying GitHub through the gh CLI: topic searches for repos, outbound links extracted from curated awesome-list READMEs for sites, and the owner's repo inventory and git-tree metadata. Each run prints a JSON summary; only `report` works offline, counting the existing catalogs.
when: حدّث فهرس المستودعات الإبداعية من GitHub / rebuild the 1,000 creative websites list from the awesome lists
how: report: `python3 scripts/rea_creative_research_atlas.py report`; repos: `python3 scripts/rea_creative_research_atlas.py repos --limit 1000 --pages 2`; sites: `python3 scripts/rea_creative_research_atlas.py sites --limit 1000`; own: `python3 scripts/rea_creative_research_atlas.py own --private-output ~/kosif-private/`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool rea-creative-research-atlas`. Limits: Collects GitHub search metadata and links scraped from awesome-list READMEs only; despite its name it does not run REA, analyse code, or verify licences or site availability, and only `report` works offline.
params: in: An action (own|repos|sites|trees|report); --limit (default 1000); --pages (default 2, repos only); --private-output folder (required for own and trees). Every action except report needs network access and an authenticated gh CLI. · out: repos and sites overwrite the tracked catalogs in data/rea-creative-research/ (public_repos.json, creative_websites.json, *_discovery_errors.json). own and trees write *_PRIVATE_LOCAL.json files into --private-output. Every action prints a JSON summary.

what: ينفّذ ثمانية استعلامات بحث إضافية حسب الموضوع على GitHub عبر أداة gh، ويدمج نتائجها في فهرس المستودعات الإبداعية. ثم يستبعد الصفوف التي تبدو ترويجًا لنماذج غير موثّقة، ويعيد كتابة الملف data/rea-creative-research/public_repos.json في 1,000 صف وفق حصص ثابتة لكل فئة. — Runs eight extra GitHub topic searches via gh and merges the results into the creative repo catalog. It drops rows that look like unverified-model marketing, then rewrites data/rea-creative-research/public_repos.json as 1,000 rows under fixed per-category quotas.
when: الفهرس فيه فيديو كتير وصور قليل، وازنه / rebalance the creative repo index so image tools are represented
how: run: `python3 scripts/rebalance_creative_repos.py run`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool rebalance-creative-repos`. Limits: Rewrites the catalog from GitHub search metadata using fixed quotas. It has no dry-run, no backup and no tests, and it analyses no code.
params: in: None (no arguments). It reads data/rea-creative-research/public_repos.json and needs an authenticated gh CLI. · out: Overwrites data/rea-creative-research/public_repos.json (1,000 rows) and rebalance_errors.json, and prints JSON with the unique count, category counts, excluded-marketing count and query errors.

what: يبحث في سجلٍّ محلي منسَّق يضم 31 مستودعًا على GitHub جرت مراجعتها (مع لقطة مؤرَّخة لأعلى عشرة مستودعات Python من حيث عدد النجوم)، ويعيد بصيغة JSON مصادر مرجعية مرتبة مع ترخيص كلٍّ منها وتحذيراته وضوابط إعادة استخدام الكود. — Searches a curated offline registry of 31 reviewed GitHub repositories (plus a dated top-10 Python star snapshot) and returns ranked reference sources with licence, caution and code-reuse gates as JSON.
when: عايز مستودع مرجعي أتعلم منه إزاي أعمل محرر موشن بتايملاين / find a reference repo for persistent agent memory before we build it
how: check: `python3 scripts/source_scout.py check`; list: `python3 scripts/source_scout.py list --domain creative`; show: `python3 scripts/source_scout.py show SRC-16`; suggest: `python3 scripts/source_scout.py suggest "keyframes timeline animation" --limit 3 --code-reuse`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool source-scout`. Limits: Matches keywords against a fixed hand-reviewed list of 31 repositories and a dated star snapshot; it fetches nothing live and does not install, run or prove any listed repository works.
params: in: Free-text query in English or Arabic (suggest), a source id like SRC-16 or owner/repo (show), optional --domain (agents, architecture, collaboration, creative, data, engineering, finance, learning, media, operations, prompts, python, research), --limit, --code-reuse; reads data/community_sources.json. · out: JSON on stdout: registry validation status, source lists, one source record, ranked suggestions with url/licence/why (Arabic)/reuse_gate/caution, or the Python top-10 snapshot. On an invalid registry or a `show` id that is not found it exits 2 and prints only {status: catalog_error, error_type} on stderr.

what: تطبيق تفاعلي مكتوب بلغة sh يعمل في a-Shell على الآيفون. ينزّل الفيديو أو الصوت عبر yt-dlp (رابط مفرد، أو دفعة روابط، أو جزء من فيديو، أو مع الترجمة، أو من صفحات فيسبوك بأفضل جهد ممكن)، وينشئ نسخ MP4 بترميز H.264/AAC متوافقة مع تطبيق الصور. ويوفّر استوديو ffmpeg يعمل دون اتصال (قص، وضغط إلى 16 أو 25 أو 50 ميغابايت، ومقاطع ريلز 9:16 بخلفية مموّهة، وGIF، وصورة غلاف، وضبط الجهارة على ‎-14 LUFS، وحذف فترات الصمت، وكتم الصوت، واستخراج الصوت وحده)، ومعملًا صوتيًا لفصل الصوت البشري عن الموسيقى. — An interactive POSIX-sh app for a-Shell on iPhone. It downloads video or audio with yt-dlp (single links, batches, part of a video, subtitles, best-effort Facebook profiles), makes Photos-safe H.264/AAC MP4 copies, and offers an offline ffmpeg Studio (trim, compress to 16/25/50 MB, 9:16 reels with blurred fill, GIF, cover JPG, -14 LUFS loudness, cut pauses, mute, audio only) and an Audio Lab for separating voice and music.
when: نزّل الفيديو ده على الآيفون من a-Shell / Download a TikTok on my iPhone with a-Shell and save it to Photos
how: download (interactive): `sh tools/a-shell/Cinema_C_V34_Studio_iPhone.sh "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID"`; --photos/--files/-N/--output: `sh tools/a-shell/Cinema_C_V34_Studio_iPhone.sh --files -N 4 --output ./downloads "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID"`; --batch: `sh tools/a-shell/Cinema_C_V34_Studio_iPhone.sh --batch ./links.txt`; --studio: `sh tools/a-shell/Cinema_C_V34_Studio_iPhone.sh --studio ./in.mp4`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool repo-ashell-cinema`. Limits: It is built for a-Shell on iPhone and has never been run on a real iPhone (only container simulations are recorded); most flows are interactive menus rather than scriptable flags, and Facebook profile enumeration is best-effort.
params: in: A video or reel URL, or a whole share text (or the clipboard via pbpaste). Optionally a links.txt file, local media files (from ~/Documents/Cinema_Downloads or a path), a Netscape cookies file and a Replicate token. Interactive menu choices are read from stdin. · out: Media files in ~/Documents/Cinema_Downloads (override with CINEMA_DOWNLOAD_DIR or --output), Photos-safe copies, Studio results in Cinema_Downloads/Studio (mp4, gif, jpg, m4a), Audio Lab results in Cinema_Downloads/Audio_Lab, history.txt, and state, cache and models in ~/Documents/.cinema.
install: needs on PATH: ffmpeg, sh, yt-dlp · optional: bin:curl, bin:open, bin:pbpaste, bin:pip

what: موجّه للقراءة فقط يربط كلمة واحدة تصف الهدف من قائمة ثابتة فيها 29 كلمة (مثل dotnet وapk وhar وfirmware وsqlite) بواحدة من 16 عائلة قدرات في REA، ويذكر اسم الأداة الأصلية وحالة توفّرها. ويبيّن كذلك هل rea وnode موجودان في PATH. — Read-only router that maps one target keyword from a fixed 29-word list (dotnet, apk, har, firmware, sqlite and others) to one of 16 REA capability families, giving the upstream tool name and availability status. It also reports whether rea and node are on PATH.
when: أي أمر في REA يناسب ملف APK؟ / which REA tool handles a HAR network capture?
how: list: `python3 scripts/rea_family_router.py list`; route: `python3 scripts/rea_family_router.py route dotnet`; doctor: `python3 scripts/rea_family_router.py doctor`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool rea-family-router`. Limits: Maps one exact keyword from a fixed list to a REA family and tool name. It does not understand free text, never runs or installs REA and never confirms the tool exists in the installed version (verified is always false; provider_version is always 'unknown').
params: in: An action (list, route or doctor). route also takes a single intent keyword from the built-in map: application-binary, native, binary, dotnet, c#, javascript, asar, source-map, apk, android, zip, ios-package, chrome, website, electron, v8, node, har, saz, qlog, network-capture, process, firmware, sqlite, go, rust, plist, app-graph or evidence. · out: JSON on stdout: the full family map, one routing record or an environment probe.

name_ar: تحليل REA لمستودعات المالك دفعةً واحدة
what: تحليل REA ساكن على دفعات لمستودعات المستخدم على GitHub المكتوبة بـ JavaScript أو TypeScript أو HTML. يقرأ جردًا خاصًا يُنشئه الأمر rea_creative_research_atlas.py own، ثم يستنسخ بـ git أصغر المستودعات المؤهَّلة ضمن حدّ الحجم استنساخًا سطحيًا (عمق 1 وblob:none)، ويشغّل عليها أمر REA analyze-javascript-application عبر node. تبقى النسخ والأدلة في مجلد خاص محلي، ولا يطبع إلا الأعداد. — Batch static REA analysis of the user's own JavaScript, TypeScript and HTML GitHub repositories. It reads a private inventory (made by rea_creative_research_atlas.py own), shallow-clones the smallest eligible repos under a size cap with git (depth 1, blob:none) and runs REA's analyze-javascript-application on each through node. Clones and evidence stay in a local private folder, and only counts are printed.
when: حلّل مستودعاتي على GitHub بـ REA دفعة واحدة / run REA statically over all my owned JS repos
how: run: `python3 scripts/rea_owned_repo_batch.py --private-output "$HOME/kosif-private" --rea-cli ./node_modules/rea-agents/scripts/rea.mjs --max-repos 16 --max-size-kb 8000`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool rea-owned-repo-batch`. Limits: Analyzes only JS, TS and HTML repos under the size cap, using REA's static JavaScript analyzer. It does not verify runtime features, build the inventory or install REA.
params: in: --private-output <existing local folder holding owner_repositories_PRIVATE_LOCAL.json; it must not itself contain .git> and --rea-cli <path to the installed REA CLI .mjs>. Optional: --max-size-kb (default 8000) and --max-repos (default 16). · out: Clones go to <private-output>/source_clones/, per-repo REA JSON to <private-output>/rea_evidence/, and a running rea_owned_repo_results_PRIVATE_LOCAL.json is kept. stdout gets START/RESULT progress lines and a public counts-only summary.
install: npm install rea-agents · needs on PATH: git, node, python3

what: يفحص مجلد مستودع محليًا أو ملف ZIP للشيفرة المصدرية بحثًا عن اللغات وإشارات القدرات وملفات التراخيص، ويبني بصمة SHA-256 لكل ملف. ثم يحزم الشيفرة في ملف ZIP مُرشَّح يتكرّر ناتجه حرفيًا، ويرفق به تقرير JSON لنقل القدرات. يستبعد مجلدات البناء والأرشيفات والملفات التنفيذية والصوت والفيديو والمفاتيح وقواعد البيانات والملفات التي توحي أسماؤها بأسرار، ولا يشغّل أي شيفرة ولا يستوردها ولا يثبّتها. — Inspects a local repository folder or source ZIP for languages, capability signals, license files and a per-file SHA-256 manifest. It packs a deterministic, filtered source ZIP plus a JSON capability-transfer report, leaving out build caches, archives, executables, audio and video, keys, databases and files whose names suggest secrets. Nothing is run, imported or installed.
when: جهّز نسخة نظيفة من هذا المستودع لنقل قدراته / inspect a repo for reusable capabilities and licenses
how: inspect: `python3 scripts/repository_capability_packer.py inspect ./repo --out ./repo-report.json`; pack: `python3 scripts/repository_capability_packer.py pack ./repo --out ./out/repo.zip --report ./out/report.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool repository-capability-packer`. Limits: Infers candidate capabilities from file names and extensions only, and filters secrets by file name, not content. Images, fonts and PDFs stay in the ZIP. It never runs, imports, clones or licenses the code.
params: in: A local source folder or an existing ZIP archive; for a GitHub source ZIP the single top folder is stripped. inspect takes an optional --out <json>; pack needs --out <zip> outside the input folder and takes an optional --report <json>. · out: A summary JSON report on stdout. inspect --out writes the full report with the sha256 manifest. pack writes the ZIP, overwriting any file already at --out, and with --report writes the report. Blocked inputs print 'repository pack blocked: …' to stderr and exit with code 2.

what: خادم MCP مستقل يعمل عبر stdio بالمكتبة القياسية وحدها، ويمنح عميل MCP إحدى عشرة أداة محصورة في مساحة عمل واحدة يوافق عليها المستخدم: الحالة، ومعلومات النظام، وسرد المجلد، وبيانات الملف، والقراءة، والبحث، ثم الإنشاء والكتابة والاستبدال والنقل وتشغيل أوامر من قائمة مسموحة. وتبقى الكتابة وتشغيل الأوامر معطّلين حتى يفعّلهما المستخدم بمتغيرات بيئة. — A self-contained stdio MCP server (standard library only) that gives an MCP client 11 tools scoped to one approved workspace: health, system info, list, file info, read, search, plus create, write, replace, move and an allowlisted command runner. Writes and commands stay off until the user sets an environment flag.
when: خلّي كلاود يقرأ ملفات مجلد مشروعي على جهازي / Give my MCP client read-only access to one project folder
how: doctor: `python3 scripts/kosif_remote_superpowers.py doctor`; demo: `python3 scripts/kosif_remote_superpowers.py demo`; serve: `KOSIF_REMOTE_ROOT=./project python3 scripts/kosif_remote_superpowers.py serve`; tools/list (one-shot): `printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | KOSIF_REMOTE_ROOT=./project python3 scripts/kosif_remote_superpowers.py serve`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool kosif-remote-commander`. Limits: It gives bounded local stdio access to one workspace (UTF-8 text files up to 512 KB, 300 lines per read, 150 listed entries, 500 files and 35 hits per search) plus six allowlisted status and version commands, with no remote relay, pairing, desktop or UI control, or arbitrary shell.
params: in: JSON-RPC 2.0 lines on stdin. Environment: KOSIF_REMOTE_ROOT (the workspace; defaults to the current directory), KOSIF_ALLOW_WRITES=1 and KOSIF_ALLOW_EXEC=1 (opt-in). · out: JSON-RPC responses on stdout whose tool results are JSON text. doctor and demo print one JSON line. The write tools change files only inside the workspace, with atomic writes and a 512 KB cap.

what: يفحص مهارة kosif-superpowers بثلاثة عشر فحصًا لا تكتب شيئًا: ترويسة ملف SKILL.md، وسجلات القدرات، ومسارات الأدلة، وروابط Markdown النسبية، وعناوين المحتويات، والفصول المولَّدة، وعلامة العدّادات، وأسماء النماذج، والأسرار ومسارات الجلسات المسرَّبة، وملف evals/evals.json، وسجل الأدوات data/tools.json مع الملفات المولَّدة منه، وتطابق أعداد القدرات المذكورة في الوثائق الرئيسية، وبنية بروتوكول USIP (نواة PROTOCOL.md وملاحق references/protocol/). ويستطيع أيضًا تشغيل تقييمات التوجيه، ثم يطبع تقريرًا نصيًا أو بصيغة JSON ويخرج بالرمز 1 عند وجود أي خطأ. — Validates the kosif-superpowers skill with 13 read-only checks: SKILL.md frontmatter, power records, proof paths, relative Markdown links, contents headings, generated chapters, the counts marker, model names, secrets and leaked session paths, evals/evals.json, the data/tools.json registry with its generated hub files, power-count drift in the entry docs, and the USIP protocol structure (PROTOCOL.md core and references/protocol/). It can also run the routing evals, then prints a text or JSON report and exits 1 on any error.
when: افحص المهارة قبل ما نعمل commit / validate the kosif-superpowers skill before packaging
how: check: `python3 scripts/check_skill.py`; --strict: `python3 scripts/check_skill.py --strict`; --json: `python3 scripts/check_skill.py --json`; --evals: `python3 scripts/check_skill.py --evals`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool check-skill`. Limits: It checks structure, links, counts and registry consistency only: the routing evals test search ranking, not whether any power works, and proofs outside this checkout are skipped rather than verified.
params: in: No file arguments. It reads SKILL.md, data/powers/*.json, data/tools.json (through scripts/hub.py), references/, proofs/, evals/evals.json and the scripts/ listing in the skill, plus the repo's tools/ listing and entry docs (README.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, CAPABILITIES.md, llms.txt). Proof paths are only tested for existence, relative to the folder that holds the repo (e.g. /home/user). · out: Text report on stdout, or one JSON object with --json. With --evals it adds a PASS/FAIL/SKIP table and the pass rate. Exit 0 = OK; exit 1 = errors, warnings under --strict, or routing below the threshold.

what: يتحقق من المهارة بالأداة check_skill.py، ثم يضغطها ضغطًا حتميًا في ملف kosif-superpowers.skill لرفعه إلى claude.ai. يضم الأرشيف مجلدًا علويًا واحدًا وملف SKILL.md واحدًا يُستبدل وصفه بالوصف القصير claude_ai_description (200 حرف على الأكثر). يستبعد dist/ ومجلدات الذاكرة المؤقتة وvendor/ وevals/، ويستبعد الوسائط أيضًا مع الخيار --lite، ثم يتحقق من الأرشيف الناتج. — Validates the skill with check_skill.py, then zips it deterministically into kosif-superpowers.skill for upload to claude.ai. The archive has a single top folder and one SKILL.md, whose description is replaced by the ≤200-character claude_ai_description. dist/, caches, vendor/, evals/ and (with --lite) media are left out, and the finished archive is re-verified.
when: حزّم المهارة عشان أرفعها على claude.ai / package the skill for upload to claude.ai
how: package: `python3 scripts/package_skill.py`; --lite: `python3 scripts/package_skill.py --lite`; --out: `python3 scripts/package_skill.py --lite -o ~/out/`; --with-evals: `python3 scripts/package_skill.py --lite --with-evals -o ~/out/kosif-superpowers.skill`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool package-skill`. Limits: It only builds the upload zip and never uploads anything; no claude.ai size cap is documented, so whether claude.ai accepts a large package is untested.
params: in: The skill folder on disk: every file not excluded, including untracked ones. Options: -o/--out (a folder, or a .skill/.zip path outside the skill or under its dist/), --lite, --with-evals, --no-check, --list. · out: A zip named kosif-superpowers.skill or kosif-superpowers-lite.skill (default: dist/ inside the skill), with the top folder kosif-superpowers/ and fixed timestamps; plus a size summary on stdout. Exit 1 on validation failure, a destination inside the skill folder, a description longer than 200 characters, or archive problems (corrupt entry, wrong top folder, nested SKILL.md).

what: يعيد حساب الحقل proof_scope لكل سجل قدرة بحسب المكان الذي تشير إليه أدلته على هذا الجهاز (repo ثم session ثم archive ثم sibling ثم receipt ثم style ثم url ثم missing/none)، ويعيد كتابة ملفات data/powers/*.json في مكانها. أما مع الخيار --check فيكتفي بالإبلاغ عن عدد السجلات التي ستتغير. — Recomputes the proof_scope field of every power record from where its proof entries resolve on this machine (repo > session > archive > sibling > receipt > style > url > missing/none) and rewrites data/powers/*.json in place. With --check it only reports how many records would change.
when: حدّث proof_scope لكل القدرات / recompute proof_scope on every power record
how: relabel: `python3 scripts/relabel_proofs.py`; --check: `python3 scripts/relabel_proofs.py --check`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool relabel-proofs`. Limits: It labels where a proof points, not whether the proof is valid: 'sibling' is assigned from the path shape alone without checking the other repository, and 'repo' only means the file exists.
params: in: data/powers/*.json and the repository files that 'kosif-tool/...' proof paths point to (existence only). The only recognised argument is --check. · out: Updated data/powers/*.json (relabel mode) and two stdout lines: proven counts by scope, and the number of records relabelled or that would change.

what: يتحقق من ملفات JSON التي تضم دفعات من الملفات الإبداعية بصيغة {"briefs": [...]}، ويكتب styles/<id>/BRIEF.md لكل ملف مقبول، ويدمج حقول الملخص في catalog/styles.json وcatalog/prompts_motion.json وcatalog/briefs.json وفي ملف STYLE.json لكل أسلوب. — Validates batch JSON files of creative briefs ({"briefs": [...]}), writes styles/<id>/BRIEF.md for each accepted brief, and merges the brief summary fields into catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json, catalog/briefs.json and each STYLE.json.
when: استورد ملفات البريف الجديدة للكتالوج / Import a batch of creative briefs into the atlas
how: import: `python3 tools/import_briefs.py ./briefs/`; --strict: `python3 tools/import_briefs.py ./briefs/ --strict`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool repo-import-briefs`. Limits: It checks only shape and simple ranges, not originality or accuracy; without --strict it imports briefs that fail the range checks, it accepts only ids already in the catalog, and it does not rebuild SKILL.md or STYLE_INDEX.md (run build.py).
params: in: A folder of *.json files, each {"briefs": [...]}. Required brief keys: id, title_ar, summary_ar, summary_en, concept_ar, concept_en, aspect, assumptions_en, scenes_en, scenes_ar, motion_rules_en, motion_rules_ar, stack, keywords, facts_from_source, duration_s and difficulty. revised_from_video (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional. Each id must already exist in catalog/styles.json. · out: Writes styles/<id>/BRIEF.md (bilingual, with a provenance note) and styles/<id>/STYLE.json, and rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and catalog/briefs.json. Prints 'imported N briefs; M total in catalog/briefs.json' to stdout and any issues to stderr.

what: يقرأ فهرس مكتبة PromptsMotion العامة وصفحات تفاصيلها ويخزّنها مؤقتًا في ‎.cache/promptsmotion/‎، ثم يستخرج البيانات الوصفية الواقعية فقط، ويعيد كتابة catalog/styles.json وcatalog/prompts_motion.json وملف STYLE.json لكل أسلوب، ويضع listed=false على الإدخالات التي خرجت من الفهرس. — Scrapes the public PromptsMotion library index and its detail pages (cached under .cache/promptsmotion/), extracts factual metadata only, rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and every styles/<id>/STYLE.json, and flags entries that have left the index with listed=false.
when: حدّث كتالوج الأساليب من مكتبة PromptsMotion / Sync the style catalog with the PromptsMotion library
how: sync: `python3 tools/sync_catalog.py`; --offline: `python3 tools/sync_catalog.py --offline`; --refetch: `python3 tools/sync_catalog.py --refetch`; --limit/--workers: `python3 tools/sync_catalog.py --limit 20 --workers 3`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool repo-sync-catalog`. Limits: It parses only the site's current markup with regexes, stores metadata and links only, does not regenerate SKILL.md, STYLE_INDEX.md or briefs (build.py does), and drops every non-PromptsMotion record that is missing from its hard-coded BASE list.
params: in: The public index at https://www.promptsmotion.com and its detail pages, or the cached copies under .cache/promptsmotion/ with --offline; also the existing catalog/styles.json (old fields are carried over) and catalog/categories.json (tag-to-category mapping). · out: Rewrites catalog/styles.json, catalog/prompts_motion.json and styles/<id>/STYLE.json for every record (it creates styles/<id>/ folders for new entries), and caches raw HTML under .cache/promptsmotion/ (gitignored). A summary (records, new, changed, unlisted) goes to stderr. Run python3 tools/build.py and python3 tools/validate.py afterwards.

name_ar: مكتبة KOSIF الشاملة للخطوط وأفكار التصميم من صادرات تيليجرام
name_en: KOSIF Telegram Typography Atlas — private-safe font knowledge and idea search
what: ابحث في فهرس بيانات 5,514 خطًا فريدًا من صادرات تيليجرام الخاصة بك (4,634 تدعم العربية): صف لكل عائلة بأوزانها، وكلمات الأنماط بالعربي (كوفي، رقعة، ديواني، ثلث، نسخ) مع تسامح الإملاء، وفلتر للرخص المفتوحة، و16 اتجاهًا تصميميًا أصليًا. الخطوط والرسائل والصور والمسارات تبقى على جهازك فقط. — Search a public metadata index of the 5,514 SHA-256-distinct fonts found in the user's own Telegram Desktop exports (4,634 with Arabic letters): one row per family with its styles, Arabic spelling-tolerant style words (كوفي، رقعة، ديواني، ثلث، نسخ), an open-license filter, and 16 original design directions. scan/enrich-zips rebuild the index on the user's machine (bounded, in-memory ZIP reads); refresh re-derives tags, name-based license flags, ideas and counts from the public index alone. Fonts, chats, images and local paths never leave the device.
when: اختار لي خط رقعة أو كوفي أو ديواني من مكتبة خطوطي لبوستر أو شعار مع حالة الرخصة / Pick an Arabic or Latin font for a logo, poster, brand, reel or kinetic text from the fonts the user already collected
how: find: `python3 scripts/telegram_typography_atlas.py find --index data/telegram-typography-catalog-complete-20261020.json "خط رقعة" --arabic-only --limit 15`; find (open licenses only): `python3 scripts/telegram_typography_atlas.py find --index data/telegram-typography-catalog-complete-20261020.json "kufi logo" --arabic-only --latin --license open`; doctor: `python3 scripts/telegram_typography_atlas.py doctor`; refresh: `python3 scripts/telegram_typography_atlas.py refresh --index data/telegram-typography-catalog-complete-20261020.json --out ./refreshed.json`. Full card: `python3 scripts/hub.py tool telegram-typography-atlas`. what: يدرس صفحة ويب عامة للقراءة فقط: متصفح بلا تسجيل دخول وملف شخصي جديد يُحذف بعد التشغيل، ثم يلتقط REA الصفحة وأدوات WebMCP المعلنة ولقطة شاشة والسكربتات العامة ببصمات SHA-256. التقرير حقائق فقط: الإطار وإصداره، ومكتبات اللوحة والمحرر والتزامن، والخدمات المستنتجة من أسماء مفاتيح التخزين، بدليل اسم ملف ومعرّف، وبلا أي كود. — Studies one public web page read-only: a logged-out headless Chromium with a fresh profile and background networking off (fresh profile, deleted afterwards), then REA captures the page, page-declared WebMCP tools, a screenshot and the public scripts, with SHA-256 receipts; optional bounded static JavaScript analysis. report turns a study folder into facts only: framework and versions, canvas/editor/realtime libraries, services inferred from storage key NAMES, WebMCP tools and page metrics, each with file-and-identifier evidence and never code.
